catalogues.notes: Co-organised with the Jingdezhen institute. Jiang Jianxin's interregnum essay (S27) first appeared in this catalogue. Earlier related shows: CUHK Art Museum 'Filling the Interregnum' (2012) and 'Refilling the Interregnum II' (2018, S35).

facts.text: No Hongwu imperial ware with a formal reign mark has been found, at the kiln site or among pieces handed down; reign marks start under Yongle.
facts.quote_zh: [S32] 虽然早在洪武二年（1369年）朝廷即在景德镇珠山设陶厂（建文四年更名为“御器厂”，清代更名“御窑厂”）专门烧造宫廷用瓷,但迄今为止，尚未发现署正规年款的洪武朝御窑瓷器。 ／ [S27] 从款式制度上看，洪武时不写年款，永乐才出现刻、印“永乐年制”篆书款，且仅见靶盏一类的制品。

facts.text: The Palace Museum and Jiang Jianxin (Jingdezhen institute) date the imperial works at Zhushan to Hongwu 2 (1369), on the strength of Hongwu-period finds at the site.
facts.quote_zh: [S06] 景德镇是闻名于世的瓷都，自明代洪武二年（1369年）开始，朝廷即在景德镇珠山设陶厂（建文四年更名为“御器厂”、清代更名“御窑厂”）专门烧造宫廷用瓷，直至清代最后一朝宣统止，几乎历朝都沿袭这种制度。 ／ [S24] 于是有关洪武官窑设置之年，学界便根据有关文献持有洪武二年和洪武三十五年(建文四年) 两说，从近年珠山出土洪武官窑纪年遗物及相关考证来看，洪武二年建厂说似较为可靠；
facts.note: Contested: see next fact (PKU 2014 excavation argues for late Hongwu).

facts.text: The 2014 Peking University-led excavation found Yuan-to-early-Ming layers in the central site but no official Hongwu workshop deposits there, and concludes the imperial factory was founded only late in the Hongwu reign. This contradicts the 1369 date.
facts.quote_zh: [S29] 本次发掘揭露的元末明初地层和以往的其他发掘资料表明，从元末到洪武时期， 在今御窑厂范围内并未建立官方经营的御器厂。 ／ [S30] 发掘中清理的元代和明初的地层，证明了明御器厂的始建年代当在洪武末期，了解了御器厂创建以前这一区域的窑业基础；
facts.note: S29 and S30 come from the same PKU team, so they are not independent of each other, but both are published by the excavators.

facts.text: Large quantities of Hongwu imperial porcelain were excavated at the Zhushan factory site in 1995; Jiang Jianxin treats this as what clarified the Hongwu type.
facts.quote_zh: [S24] 1964年南京明故宫玉带河发现一批洪武瓷片，1984年北京第四中学基建工地也出土了数千片洪武瓷片，随着为数不少的洪武纪年墓瓷器出土和日本学者对传世172件洪武瓷器的统计研究，尤其是1995年珠山明御厂故址洪武官窑瓷器的大量出土，人们对洪武器的认识便日愈清晰了。 ／ [S28] 在御窑厂遗址的考古发掘过程中，我们考古团队已经相继发掘了洪武官窑，永乐官窑、宣德官窑以及成化官窑的非常完整的遗物，而且都是成系列的，在全世界做了很多的展览。
facts.note: Both quotes are from Jiang Jianxin (one author).

facts.text: A white roof tile from a Hongwu stratum (1990, east foot of Zhushan) bears a brushed iron inscription naming workmen and supervisors, including a Fuliang county assistant magistrate. This is a production inscription, not a reign mark.
facts.quote_zh: [S24] (1) 1990年景德镇明御厂故址珠山东麓洪武地层出土一批白瓷板瓦，据考，该瓦是为洪武十年南京故宫建社稷坛而烧造的。

facts.text: Hongwu cobalt blue comes in two tones, a dark blue with blurring close to Yuan but greyer, and a dull grey. Copper-red glaze is thin and slightly yellowish, and underglaze red runs greyish. Jiang reports Shanghai Institute of Ceramics tests showing the same high-iron, low-manganese imported cobalt as Yuan.
facts.quote_zh: [S24] (二)产品主要特征1、关于青花料，洪武青花色泽总体上看不如元青花浓艳凝重，传世与出土的洪武青花有二种明显的色泽：一种近似元青花，色泽深蓝，有晕散感，但比元青花偏灰；一种呈暗灰色，显一点淡蓝色。 ／ [S24] 洪武釉里红总体来看均偏灰，既不如元代的红色纯正，也没有永乐后期色釉鲜艳，红中偏灰是洪武釉里红的时代特征。

facts.text: Forms Jiang singles out as Hongwu: very large straight-walled bowls about 40 cm across with broad shallow feet and unglazed sand bases, and ewers with three metalwork-style rivets at the lower handle join.
facts.quote_zh: [S24] 一为直壁大碗，口径约40厘米左右，圈足大而浅，砂底，此类大碗为洪武时特有。 ／ [S24] 壶身为玉壶春瓶形，弯流细长与壶口平高，足底有釉，流与颈部有一云板饰件相连，有趣的是壶柄下端接头有三个仿金属器皿的铆钉，此为洪武执壶所独有的装饰。

facts.text: Hongwu patterns, per Jiang: lotus panels share borders, key-fret runs in paired opposing units, and the base centre of white and red wares is incised with one or 'pin'-arranged folded-ribbon clouds, a motif Yongle carried on.
facts.quote_zh: [S24] 根据对洪武时代纹饰排比观察可见：第一，莲瓣纹每瓣的边框相互借用连接，大莲瓣内绘小朵宝相团花或如意纹为洪武首创；第二，回纹多数已成正反二回一组的结构，与元代同向回纹相异；

facts.text: Most Yongle imperial wares carry no mark. Where there is one it reads only 永乐年制, in four characters, always in seal script. Six-character 大明永乐年制 marks are later copies.
facts.quote_zh: [S32] 永乐朝虽开明代御窑瓷器署帝王“年号款”之先河，但永乐朝御窑瓷器中的绝大多数并不署年款，少数带年款者其款字内容仅见有“永乐年制”四字，不见有“大明永乐年制”六字。 ／ [S32] 目前所见署“大明永乐年制”六字款的陶瓷器，从各方面特征看均为后仿品。 ／ [S27] 从款式制度上看，洪武时不写年款，永乐才出现刻、印“永乐年制”篆书款，且仅见靶盏一类的制品。

facts.text: Yongle marks are executed in three ways: written in cobalt (only on the 'press-hand' cups, 压手杯), incised, or moulded. The incised and moulded marks sit under monochrome white or red glaze in the inside centre of bowls, dishes and stem bowls, so they show only against the light. The 1982 dig found stem cups with an impressed 永乐年制 in the centre.
facts.quote_zh: [S32] 按署款方式不同，“永乐年制”四字可分为以青花料书写款、锥拱款和模印款三种。 ／ [S32] 锥拱款和模印款主要见于永乐甜白釉、鲜红釉等单色釉瓷器上，位置多在碗、盘、高足碗等器物的内底中心或内壁，款字均作两行排列于葵花心或单线圈内。 ／ [S31] 第4层为淡红土夹沙层，厚约5~45厘米，其中杂有少量的白瓷残片和青花盘残片，几个高足杯底心印有“永乐年制”四字篆文款；

facts.text: A red-glazed stem bowl with a moulded Yongle mark was excavated at the northern foot of Zhushan in 2003. On fully red-glazed pieces the moulded mark is usually illegible.
facts.quote_zh: [S32] 图五：明代永乐款鲜红釉模印云龙纹高足碗，2003年出土于景德镇市珠山北麓景德镇市陶瓷考古研究所藏 ／ [S32] 其中内、外施鲜红釉者所署年款除了极个别的字迹较清晰外（图五，1、2、3），其余均模糊不清。

facts.text: Underglaze-red sherds inscribed with the dates Yongle 1 and Yongle 4 were found at Zhushan. Jiang uses them to show the official kiln was firing from Yongle 1 and to separate early Yongle red (greyish, Hongwu-like) from later pure red.
facts.quote_zh: [S24] 有关永乐官窑始烧之年，根据《江西大志·陶书》:“洪武三十五年开始烧造”(永乐执政尚未改元的特定年代)与珠山发现的一块书“永乐元年”铭 釉里红残片来看，永乐元年已有官窑烧造了。 ／ [S24] 如早期据“永乐元年”与“永乐肆年”铭釉里红标本来看，色调还保留洪武时代红里泛灰的特点； 而后期则色调纯正，如珠山出土的红釉地白龙纹靶盏，釉里红三鱼靶杯等色调均纯正艳丽。

facts.text: Palace Museum 'press-hand' cups (压手杯) had been doubted as Yongle on grounds of mark and thickness. A 压手杯 from a Yongle stratum at the factory site in 2014 confirmed them.
facts.quote_zh: [S28] 例如永乐压手杯，虽有传世品，但早期因故宫学者将其定为永乐年间器物时，不少学者仍质疑其款识、厚度与永乐时代风格不符。 ／ [S28] 直至2014 年御窑厂永乐地层出土永乐压手杯，才与传世品相互印证。

facts.text: Stratigraphy has redated transmitted pieces. A large censer Geng Baochang had called Xuande turned up in a Yongle stratum, and a kiln-site blue-and-white tripod censer matches a Palace Museum piece almost exactly.
facts.quote_zh: [S28] 过去耿先生把永乐时代的大香炉定为宣德时期，但是我们这个是永乐时期地层，和永乐官窑同时出土，那么就把它的年代厘清了。 ／ [S09] 例如在本次展览中，有一件御窑遗址考古出土的永乐青花海水纹双耳三足炉（图2）。 ／ [S10] 与之同时对比陈列的，是故宫博物院藏的一件传世品，两炉的器型、纹样几乎完全一致。
facts.note: S09/S10 give the censer match; the Geng Baochang redating rests on S28 only.

facts.text: Yongle forms modelled on Islamic metalwork are known from the kiln site, including octagonal candlesticks and moon flasks. The site also produced very tall sweet-white (tianbai) vases that are not otherwise known.
facts.quote_zh: [S12] 比如３件永乐年间的八方烛台就是模仿伊斯兰风格的黄铜嵌金、银制品烧造而成，另两件用于装水的青花如意耳扁壶，也是永乐时期对同样造型的伊斯兰嵌金、银壶造型的模仿。 ／ [S12] 以一个永乐甜白釉大花瓶为例，他说，如果不发掘出土这件大花瓶，人们永远不可能知道永乐时期的御窑厂还烧造如此高大的器皿。 ／ [S24] 另有双耳三足大香炉、八棱烛台、梵文大杓、笔盒、带盖瓷豆、深腹平底洗、花浇和筒形器座(又称无档尊)等，均为永乐罕见的创新之作。

facts.text: Yongle copper red is purer than Hongwu's and shows a white 'lamp-wick' rim at mouth and foot. Kingfisher-green (翠青) glaze is a Yongle invention. Low-temperature glazes and overglaze enamels, unknown among transmitted Yongle pieces, have been found in Yongle strata.
facts.quote_zh: [S24] 永乐红釉一改洪武器微泛黄的特点，红色调较为纯正，尤其是口足一圈白而肥润的“灯草边”使红釉更显深厚夺目。 ／ [S24] 4、低温釉及釉上彩器无论是低温釉彩；还是釉上彩瓷，过去均不见有传世品，近年珠山明御厂永乐地层有发现。

facts.text: Yongle blue-and-white is deep blue with blurring. Decoration is sparer than Hongwu's, and Yongle first painted the inside of bowl bases.
facts.quote_zh: [S24] 永乐青花纹饰一改洪武那种繁缛茂密的元青花遗风而更趋疏朗清丽。 ／ [S24] 永乐首开青花装饰碗底先例，纹饰有龙、凤、菊和龟锦纹(实为唐金银器上的忍冬花结纹)。

facts.text: Nearly all Xuande imperial wares are marked. Kiln-site and transmitted pieces show marks in regular script (楷) and seal script (篆), executed in cobalt, incised, in iron-brown or in overglaze red, in four or six characters. They are arranged in one, two or three lines and framed by double rings, single rings or rectangles.
facts.quote_zh: [S24] c、关于款识从出土与传世的宣德瓷器来看，其时的制品绝大多数都有年款，并有固定的形式。 ／ [S24] 书体有楷书和篆书二种，从工艺与装饰形式上看有：刻款、青花款、铁绘款与釉上矾红款；字数有四字、六字；排列形式有单行(横 排、竖排)、双行、三行排列；有加双圈、单圈或长方单框之类。 ／ [S32] 从字数来看，可分为“大明宣德年制”和“宣德年制”两种；从书写方式来看，可分为以青花料书写款、以铁红釉书写款、以矾红彩书写款以及锥拱款和模印款等；

facts.text: Xuande mark placement is not fixed ('Xuande marks all over the vessel'). Bowls and dishes are marked on the base, large dishes below the outer rim, and vases and jars on the shoulder. The commonest format is six characters 大明宣德年制 in two lines of regular script within a double ring, a format later reigns adopted as standard.
facts.quote_zh: [S24] 宣德碗盘底多施釉，款识流行书于器底，大盘则书于外壁口沿处，瓶罐类则多书于器物之肩部，还有在同一器物上书写二个年款的(如蟋蟀罐和笔盒)故前人有 “宣德款识满器身”之说。 ／ [S32] 其中以青花楷书六字双行排列外围双线圆圈款最为常见。 ／ [S32] 宣德御窑开创的在御窑瓷器上署楷体六字双行外围双圈的款式，成为后来御窑瓷器上使用最多、延续时间最长的款式。

facts.text: Six-character Xuande marks are always in regular script. Four-character 宣德年制 marks occur in both regular and seal script. Cobalt seal-script four-character marks are unknown among transmitted pieces and have been found only on kiln-site stem bowls (1982 onward), double-ringed in the inside centre.
facts.quote_zh: [S32] “大明宣德年制”六字款均为楷体，“宣德年制”四字款既有楷体也有篆体。 ／ [S32] 青花篆书四字年款极罕见，迄今为止，传世品中未见一例，景德镇市珠山明代御器厂遗址曾出土宣德仿汝釉高足碗和青花高足碗残片标本，其内底中心署青花篆体四字年款，四字分双行排列，外围青花双线圈（图十四）。 ／ [S25] 天青釉把盏：有四字宜德篆款和无款两种，有款的高11.7厘米，盏心书青花双行双圈四字篆款。

facts.text: In four-character regular-script Xuande marks, the 心 of 德 has no horizontal stroke above it. In the four-character seal-script marks it does.
facts.quote_zh: [S32] 应引起注意的是，宣德御窑瓷器所署楷体四字年款之“德”字“心”上无横画，而所署篆体四字年款之“德”字“心”上有横画。

facts.text: Two marks on one vessel: excavated cricket jars carry the mark both inside the cover and on the base, horizontal in one place and vertical in the other or both double-ringed depending on cover type. Covered bowls are marked inside cover and bowl.
facts.quote_zh: [S25] 盖中心有一小孔，似作盖纽之用，盖底施白釉，书“大明宜德年制”六字竖款，罐底书“大明宜德年制”六字横款。 ／ [S32] 坐盖式蟋蟀罐的盖内和外底均署青花楷体六字年款，盖内自右向左横写一排、外底竖写一行（图十六，1、2）。

facts.text: Rare mark media found at the site: overglaze alum-red six-character double-ring marks in the centre of red-decorated stem cups, and an iron-red 大明宣德年制 double-ring mark on an iron-red glazed bowl. Jiang says red marks disappear after Xuande and return from Jiajing.
facts.quote_zh: [S25] 矾红款为宜德稀有款，宣德之后一度消失，嘉靖以后又出现，如“典膳所用”双圈款回，一直到清雍正后才流行。 ／ [S25] 铁红釉铁红六字款碗：口径15厘米，釉呈赤褐色，底书铁红“大明宜德年制”双圈双行款，为独一无二的宜德款。

facts.text: In the 1982 rescue dig in front of the old factory gate, most Xuande remains carried the cobalt six-character mark 大明宣德年制. Unmarked early-Ming pieces were found with them.
facts.quote_zh: [S25] 遗物绝大部分有青花“大明宜德年制”六字款①。 ／ [S25] 当掘至明清御厂仪门故址 (图一：A1、A2) 时，刘新园在距地表0.5米处发现了明宜德官窑青花残片，景德镇考古工作者立即进行了抢救性的清理，在东起御窑厂东墙，西至公馆岭长160米的沟道中，清理出有永乐、宜德年款以及一批无款的明初官窑残器。

facts.text: Doucai began under Xuande, not Chenghua. Xuande-stratum finds include a doucai mandarin-duck lotus dish with a cobalt 大明宣德年制 mark in a double ring on the base (1988) and semi-finished bowls of the same design with no enamels yet (1985, 1988). No identical dish is known among transmitted pieces.
facts.quote_zh: [S20] 1984 年在西藏萨迦寺发现宣德款斗彩鸳鸯莲池纹靶杯后，1985年、1988年又先后在景德镇御窑遗址宣德地层发现了斗彩鸳鸯莲池纹碗的半成品（未填釉上彩）及同类题材的盘。 ／ [S20] ”盘心绘红莲三组，并以芦苇、 红蓼、 慈姑、 浮萍等穿插其间，鸳鸯以青料勾勒，再以红、紫、黄三色画羽毛，外壁绘红莲四组并饰以红蓼、慈姑、鸳鸯两对穿插其间，足底双圈内青料书“大明宣德年制”六字楷书款。 ／ [S10] 展品中景德镇市陶瓷考古研究所藏的宣德斗彩鸳鸯莲池纹盘以及永乐红釉点彩碗就是比较典型的例子，这两种器物在传世品中均未曾见到与之相同的。

facts.text: Jiang reads the Xuande blue as both Yongle-deep and Chenghua-soft. A trial dish from a Xuande stratum inscribed 乐一号 and 乐三号 suggests Leping (domestic) cobalt was being tested.
facts.quote_zh: [S24] 这一结论与近年在珠山明御厂宣德地层出土的一块青花书“乐一号”、“乐三号”铭青花试料盘可相印证，该盘青花色调淡雅，所谓“乐一号”、“乐三号”很可能就是乐平青料(即文献记载的所谓陂塘青或平等青)。

facts.text: Sky-blue (天青) cobalt glaze was long thought a Qing invention. A sky-blue stem cup with a seal-script 宣德年制 mark in the centre, from a 1993 Xuande stratum, shows it already existed under Xuande.
facts.quote_zh: [S24] 天青釉是以钴为作色剂的高温色釉，过去一直以为天青釉创烧于清初官窑，1993年珠山明御厂宣德地层出土一盏心书“宣德年制”篆款天青釉靶盏，证实早在宣德时天青釉已经发明，并成功地用于装饰瓷器。

facts.text: Xuande mostly kept Yongle forms, and unmarked Xuande blue-and-white can be hard to tell from Yongle. On the same form, Yongle tends to be refined, delicate and thin, Xuande large, thick and heavy.
facts.quote_zh: [S24] 譬如，一些无款宣德青化瓷与永乐青花瓷便难于区分开来。 ／ [S24] 相同的器型永乐有秀、巧、薄的特点，宣德的则有大、厚、拙的特点。

facts.text: Xuande dragons are more ferocious than Yongle's, with upright, loose or forward-swept manes. Xuande also first combines flowers and fruit of different seasons on one piece, and figure scenes with garden pavilions become common.
facts.quote_zh: [S24] b、器型与纹饰：宣德与永乐官窑瓷器， 其胎、釉制作和纹饰没有多少区别，宣德器型也多沿用永乐形制，但也存在差异：宣德官窑器上的龙纹比永乐的画得更为精彩，有竖发、披发及前披发式，均显得较为凶猛。

facts.text: Imperial wares of the Zhengtong, Jingtai and Tianshun reigns (1436–1464) carry no formal reign marks. That is why the period was called the 'blank' or 'dark' period.
facts.quote_zh: [S15] 特别是由于此三朝御窑瓷器均不署正规年款，致使长期以来，人们并不认识这三朝御窑瓷器，称之为“空白期”或“黑暗期”。 ／ [S04] 长期以来大家耳熟能详的明代御窑瓷器名品有永乐、宣德青花、甜白釉、鲜红釉瓷、成化斗彩瓷、弘治浇黄釉瓷、嘉靖、隆庆、万历五彩瓷，而正统、景泰、天顺御窑瓷器却因不署年款和实物证据不足，在古陶瓷研究领域中被称之为“空白期”或“黑暗期”。 ／ [S27] 我国古陶瓷学界普遍认为明代这三朝瓷器陷于衰退期，而三朝官窑瓷器，由于不书年款，其面貌模糊不清，陶瓷史上称其为“空白期”或“黑暗期”。

facts.text: In 1988 a deposit dominated by large blue-and-white dragon vats was found by the factory's west wall. Stratigraphy and texts date it to Zhengtong, making it the first archaeologically confirmed Zhengtong imperial ware. Jiang notes the sequence: Chenghua deposits above, Xuande-marked material below, and an unmarked layer between.
facts.quote_zh: [S15] 第一次是1988年，在御窑遗址西墙、靠近东司岭巷一带发现了以青花云龙纹大缸残片为主要包含物的地层堆积。根据地层叠压关系和文献记载判断，这些青花云龙纹大缸的烧造年代为正统时期。这是首次经考古确认的正统时期御窑瓷器遗存，改写了正统朝御窑已停止烧造的既往认识。 ／ [S28] 虽然是抢救性发掘，但是它的地层信息很清晰，上面有成化官窑的堆积，底下有宣德款识，就是这中间层无款。

facts.text: In 2014 at the northern foot of Zhushan, an unmarked sherd layer was found lying over the Xuande layer and sealed by the Chenghua layer. Part of it is Xuande-like and part Chenghua-like, which dates it to Zhengtong–Tianshun. In Jiang's section this is layer 8, above which layer 7 is dominated by Chenghua-marked sherds.
facts.quote_zh: [S15] 第二次是2014年，在御器厂内珠山北麓，发现了从明代宣德至清代的地层堆积，包括叠压在宣德地层之上、又被成化地层叠压的瓷片堆积层。该地层出土的瓷器均不署年款，从一部分瓷器具有宣德御窑瓷器风格、另一部分瓷器具有成化御窑瓷器特征看，其烧造年代应为正统至天顺时期。 ／ [S27] 第⑧层出土遗物较为单纯，瓷器均无款，但种类丰富，出土器物有的与宣德相似，但与宣德和成化相比却又有差异，且均无款，根据地层和类型学分析，可知第⑧层出土瓷器应为明正统至天顺时期遗物。

facts.text: Jiang divides the 2014 layer-8 material into an earlier, Xuande-like phase and a later, Chenghua-like phase. He reads the deposit as a single dump around Tianshun 8 (1464), when imperial firing was ordered to stop. The Palace Museum show text likewise says Zhengtong carries a Xuande legacy and Zhengtong–Tianshun style shaped Chenghua.
facts.quote_zh: [S27] 由于该地层出土“空白期”遗物特征明显，根据类型学比较，其遗物似可分为二期：第一期与宣德相近；第二期则与成化相近。 ／ [S27] 因此，我以为此第⑧层的瓷器当包含正统、景泰、天顺时期遗物，而地年代当是空白期后期—即天顺八年左右的堆积。 ／ [S15] 通过对比，观众可以领略到正统朝御窑瓷器风格明显带有宣德遗风，而正统到天顺朝的御窑瓷器风格又明显影响了成化瓷器。
facts.note: The Tianshun-8 dumping interpretation is Jiang's alone (single-sourced); the two-phase style reading has two sources.

facts.text: Redating effect: unmarked transmitted pieces in Xuande or Chenghua style, formerly given to those reigns, now have to be reconsidered as interregnum wares. Jiang names the unmarked doucai mandarin-duck lotus bowls and dishes formerly called Chenghua.
facts.quote_zh: [S15] 展览对于明代御窑瓷器研究具有重要学术价值，以往人们囿于考古资料限制，将一些不署年款的具有宣德、成化御窑瓷器风格的传世瓷器年代分别定为宣德、成化。 ／ [S27] 从传世的空白期瓷器来看，主要遗物还是在北京和台北故宫博物院，比如，过去一般把无款斗彩鸳鸯莲池纹碗、盘定为成化制品，现在完全可以据出土资料把它确定为空白期官窑遗物。 ／ [S34] 在第一章节“华章再现——皇家气概官用瓷”中，有相当一部分器物过去被定为宣德和成化两朝的瓷器，在有了出土材料作为佐证后，时代被修正为十五世纪中期。

facts.text: The restored blue-and-white cloud-dragon vat is exceptionally large: the Palace show text gives over 70 cm across the mouth and over 80 cm high, Jiang 88 cm across the belly. The texts tie it to the dragon vats the Ming History says were ordered after the three halls were rebuilt in Zhengtong 6 (1441).
facts.quote_zh: [S15] 如：一组青花云龙纹大缸残片，修复后龙缸口径70多厘米，高80多厘米，形体之大，在明代绝无仅有。 ／ [S27] （一）、1988年11月珠山明御厂西墙一带发现一正统官窑遗存，（图1）出土瓷器有：青花云龙纹大缸，腹径达88厘米，器型硕大，似为明朝最大的一件瓷器（图2-1）。
facts.note: Dimensions differ between sources (mouth vs belly diameter).

facts.text: New interregnum forms from the 2014 dig include six very large blue-and-white flowerpots and blue-and-white drum stools (garden seats). Before this, Ming porcelain stools were known mostly from Zhengde onward. Ruyi-shaped pillows were also found.
facts.quote_zh: [S15] 再如，2014年景德镇明清御窑遗址出土的六件青花大花盆，外壁绘有云龙纹、海兽、麒麟等，体形硕大，颇有气势，即使在明代御窑瓷器烧造取得最高成就的永乐、宣德时期也未见有类似作品。 ／ [S15] 绣墩亦称凉凳，传世品中明代瓷绣墩多为正德、嘉靖、万历朝作品，正德朝以前的非常罕见。 ／ [S06] 展览第一单元展出的明代景德镇御窑遗址出土的永乐朝青花缠枝莲纹压手杯（残）、永乐朝釉里红花卉纹笔盒（修复）、宣德朝青花卷草纹器座（修复）以及正统至天顺朝青花折枝牡丹纹如意头形枕（修复）、青花镂空钱纹大绣墩（修复）等，均属于首次或修复后首次公开展出的重要展品，为研究明代御窑青花和釉里红瓷提供了新的实物资料。

facts.text: Zhengtong-type decoration, per Jiang: surging sea waves, sea monsters, cloud-wreathed figures (the Japanese term 'cloud-hall' 雲堂手), and the fish of the Eight Emblems drawn as a single fish. Doucai mandarin ducks are tiny and bird-like and lotus flowers large with small leaves.
facts.quote_zh: [S24] 而八吉祥纹中之“鱼”纹，画成“单鱼”；斗彩莲池鸳鸯纹中的小鸟般鸳鸯和花大而叶小的莲荷纹样均富正统特色。 ／ [S27] 大量的海水纹装饰也是此次出土正统官窑瓷器的一大特色，可视之为正统官窑瓷器典型纹样。
facts.note: Both quotes by Jiang Jianxin.

facts.text: Zhengtong cobalt is close to Xuande's: deep and dense. Material Jiang attributes to Jingtai–Tianshun is greyish-pale, with low, slightly inturned dish feet that are often not cut deeper than the shoulder.
facts.quote_zh: [S27] 其青花产品的主要特征：青花色调多偏灰淡，既不如它之前的正统青花厚重浓丽，也没有成化青花纤细淡雅；造型上（主要是靶盏、碗、盘）多承正统形制，但盘圈足矮而微内敛，挖足多不过肩;纹饰上多承正统风格，但花卉纹则较为流行。

facts.text: Jingtai–Tianshun candidates come from mixed contexts. A 1993 fill west of the old factory held Xuande-marked, Chenghua-marked and unmarked sherds with no stratigraphic order. In 1995 unmarked Xuande-like but coarser sherds were found in an early-Chenghua layer at Longzhuge.
facts.quote_zh: [S27] 图35，明御窑厂遗址出土正统--成化器2、1993年6月，在明御厂故址西侧（老市政府大楼西侧前食堂）基建工地上发现一批宣德、成化纪年官款瓷片和无款青花瓷片，这批遗物无叠压关系，可能是明早中期的扰土和填土，其中无款青花瓷片上的缠枝宝相花极似正统风格，但色泽较正统灰暗，胎、釉亦不如正统精细，盘的圈足比正统圈足大，且低矮微内敛。 ／ [S27] 3、1995年在珠山龙珠阁成化早期地层夹杂着一些无款青花靶盏和碗、盘残片，其造型和纹样与宣德器相近，但胎釉较粗，青花色调略显灰暗，与同时出土的成化青花清幽淡雅色调区别较大，这批遗物可能是正统之后成化之前的景泰或天顺官窑制品。

facts.text: The only dated inscriptions are informal ones, not reign marks. The Palace show used as a dating standard a blue-and-white dragon bowl inscribed 天顺年置, excavated in 2007 from a Ming princely family cemetery in Jiangxia, Wuhan. The exhibition page also lists a censer with a 天顺年 inscription.
facts.quote_zh: [S16] 正统、景泰、天顺三朝瓷器均不署正规年款，这件青花碗出土信息明确，所署纪年款虽非正规年款，但仍可被视作天顺御窑瓷器断代的标准器，具有重要的学术价值。 ／ [S04] “天顺年”铭青花波斯文三足炉
facts.note: The bowl is a tomb find, not a kiln find.

facts.text: Jiang's explanation for the absence of marks: Zhengtong-era retrenchment, and the fact that marking was not yet fixed practice (Hongwu unmarked, Yongle marked only rarely), so Zhengtong could follow frugal Hongwu rather than lavish Xuande. This is an interpretation, not a finding.
facts.quote_zh: [S27] 关于“空白期”官窑不书年款问题，由于当时书写年款尚未形成定制，正统官窑不效仿奢侈的宣德而追仿简朴的洪武官窑也就非常自然了，而三朝官窑不写年款就使人容易理解了。

facts.text: Chenghua imperial marks from the factory site are mostly cobalt six-character 大明成化年製 in regular script, within a double ring or a double square, usually on the base and occasionally written horizontally below the rim. The frame lines hug the characters and vary in thickness and depth of colour.
facts.quote_zh: [S26] 御窑出土的成化官款多以青花书双圈或双框“大明成化年製”六字楷书款，其款识大多在器底，少量横书于口沿下方。 ／ [S26] 款外围圆圈或框字都紧束款字，所画线条粗细不等，发色浓淡不一。 ／ [S32] 成化御窑瓷器年款的主要体式为青花楷体“大明成化年制”六字双行外围青花双圆圈或双方框，也有极个别无边栏者。

facts.text: Chenghua marks are always six characters. No four-character 成化年制 mark is known. The double-square frame was new in Chenghua, and kiln-site examples include a cup with a double-square mark.
facts.quote_zh: [S32] 一是均为“大明成化年制”六字款（图十八，1、2），不见“成化年制”四字款； ／ [S32] 二是新创一种六字双行排列外围双方框的款式（图十九，1、2、3），为以前所未见； ／ [S26] [1]图1 青花双框双行“大明成化年製”六字楷书款御窑出土的成化官款多以青花书双圈或双框“大明成化年製”六字楷书款，其款识大多在器底，少量横书于口沿下方。
facts.note: 'No four-character mark' rests on S32 only; double-frame use at the site has two sources.

facts.text: Placement exceptions: on stem cups the six characters run clockwise around the inside of the foot (a Chenghua innovation). On dishes with unglazed 'burnt-rice' bases the mark is written in one horizontal line at the rim. A rare single-line mark in a double rectangle occurs on a kiln-site bowl base.
facts.quote_zh: [S32] 另见有以青花料自右向左横写楷体六字一排年款，落在盘的口边，高足杯则在足内边沿按顺时针方向绕足书写青花楷体六字年款。 ／ [S32] 图二十一：明代成化青花碗（残片）外底署款，景德镇市珠山明代御窑遗址出土景德镇市陶瓷考古研究所藏图二十二：明代成化青花折枝莲托杂宝纹高足杯成化御窑青花、斗彩瓷器上均署青花款；单色釉瓷除署青花款外，还有少量锥拱款。

facts.text: Chenghua doucai jars with dragon, heavenly-horse, sea-monster, Eight-Emblem or lotus scroll decoration carry a single cobalt 天 ('heaven') on the base instead of the reign mark. Semi-finished 天-jars outlined in cobalt but not yet enamelled were excavated from Chenghua strata (2002–2004).
facts.quote_zh: [S32] 即：凡是以龙（包括海水云龙、应龙、香草龙、瓜地行龙等）、天马（图三十，1、2）、海怪、缠枝莲托八吉祥、缠枝莲纹等主题纹饰装饰的斗彩罐，其外底必署“天”字款；而凡绘其他纹饰者，则必署六字年款（图三十一，1、2）。 ／ [S22] 2002－2004年，珠山御窑联合考古队在珠山御窑遗址成化地层中，发掘出土了许多青花瓷片，其中不‹1›少为青料勾双线留白的残片，经修复所得器形有鸡缸杯〔图一〕、天字罐〔图三〕、缠枝莲纹小靶盏〔图五〕等。
facts.note: The jar-motif rule rests on S32; the kiln-site 天-jar semi-finished pieces on S22.

facts.text: On Chenghua blue-ground reserved-white wares, a kiln-site bowl carries its mark in raised white slip, six characters in a white-slip double ring, written on the blue-glazed base. This mark type is unique to Chenghua.
facts.quote_zh: [S32] 值得一提的是成化祭蓝釉白花瓷所署款识很特别，即在外底祭蓝釉地上以白色泥料书写楷体六字双行外围白泥双圈款（图二十三，1、2），款字笔道凸起，这种蓝釉白泥款为成化朝瓷器上所独有[13]。

facts.text: Double rings around Chenghua marks are usually darker on the outer ring, so the outer ring was drawn first. Square frames are irregular and dark at the overlapping corners. The cobalt of the characters sinks into the glaze rather than floating.
facts.quote_zh: [S32] 成化御窑瓷器年款中的青花款所围双圆圈或双方栏框的颜色深浅不一，双圈大多外圈色深，内圈色浅，说明当时是先画外圈，后画内圈；双方栏大都不太规整，四角重笔处往往色深。

facts.text: In 1987 large Chenghua kiln deposits were cleared northeast of Longzhuge. Liu Xinyuan divided them into early, middle and late phases by find-spot and stratum. In Chenghua strata, doucai semi-finished and finished pieces are the largest category.
facts.quote_zh: [S22] 1987年景德镇市陶瓷考古研究所为配合龙珠阁的建设，在龙珠阁东北侧发现清理出大量成化时期的窑业堆积，根据出土时间、区域、地层的不同，刘新园先生结合文献，把这些出土的遗物分为早、中、晚三期，‹1›第三期共计出土300余件器物，其中青花斗彩器物约200余件。 ／ [S22] 综合以上两次在珠山的较大规模的考古发掘，成化地层出土数量最多的为斗彩半成品和斗彩成品。

facts.text: Chenghua doucai drops the Xuande method of incising reserves in the leather-hard body for enamel. Areas to be enamelled are outlined in cobalt instead. Early-Chenghua iron red follows Xuande practice, shaded first and then outlined. Late Chenghua strata show flat, unshaded iron red.
facts.quote_zh: [S22] 经与同品类器物〔图二，图四，图六〕比较得知，这些青花勾线器物都为斗彩半成品，且成化斗彩瓷器制作没有沿用宣德斗彩瓷器在泥坯上暗刻留白填彩的工艺，而是在需要填彩的部位以青料勾画外轮廓线，并按照构图需要局部用画笔或点、或绘单线条，以增加层次感。 ／ [S22] 五结论宣德时期和成化早期矾红彩绘均为渲染后再勾画局部，但到了成化朝后期，由于斗彩瓷器烧造量变大，御器厂工匠开始大量采用平涂无渲染的工艺制作斗彩瓷器。

facts.text: Rejection criteria visible in excavated rejects: a blue-and-white dragon-and-phoenix dish was smashed because one inside dragon foot was painted with six claws and one outside foot with four. A doucai cup was rejected because its red had gone dark.
facts.quote_zh: [S08] 而展出的青花云龙凤纹盘则非常有趣，其内底龙的一足画成六爪、外壁龙的一足画成四爪，不知工匠有意画错还是无意为之，此盘可能即因此而落选。 ／ [S13] 只因为内底所绘本应为五爪龙的一足被粗心的匠人画成了六爪，而外壁所绘龙纹的一足又少一爪，画成了四爪，不细心看不容易发现。 ／ [S13] 但仔细看，会发现当年被砸碎的杯子颜色不及故宫藏品鲜艳，红色发乌，因此惨遭淘汰。
facts.note: The six-claw dish has two sources; the dark-red doucai cup rests on S13 only.

facts.text: The Palace Museum characterises Chenghua imperial ware by a pure white, fine body, an even oily-lustred glaze, varied subjects, balanced composition, and fresh, elegant colour.
facts.quote_zh: [S08] 成化御窑瓷器素以胎质洁白细腻、釉质平整油光、装饰题材丰富、构图疏密有致、设色清丽典雅、绘画技艺精湛而闻名于世。 ／ [S13] 成化御窑瓷器素以胎质洁白细腻、釉质平整油光、装饰题材丰富、构图疏密有致、设色清丽典雅、绘画技艺精湛而闻名于世。
facts.note: S13 repeats the Palace press text verbatim, so this is effectively one source.

facts.text: Excavated Chenghua types not matched by any transmitted piece include a blue-and-white crane-neck vase with dragons among flowers, red- and blue-ground bowls with reserved white dragons or phoenixes, a peacock-green lobed flowerpot, red-ground and white-ground green-enamelled tripod censers, and a sancai duck-shaped incense burner.
facts.quote_zh: [S08] 不见于传世品的青花龙穿花纹鹤颈瓶、祭红地抜白云龙纹碗、祭蓝地抜白云凤纹碗、孔雀绿釉菱花口折沿花盆、矾红地绿彩缠枝灵芝纹双耳三足炉、白釉绿彩缠枝灵芝纹双耳三足炉、素三彩鸭形香薰等，则给人耳目一新之感。

facts.text: Early Chenghua official ware copied Xuande models closely, for example blue-and-white dragon bowls, but carried the Chenghua mark rather than a Xuande one. The kiln site also produced Chenghua copies of the Xuande doucai mandarin-duck lotus dish.
facts.quote_zh: [S33] 从现存的成化官窑瓷器看，成化早期官窑多以模仿宣德官窑制式为主。 ／ [S33] 如英国戴维德基金会收藏成化官窑青花龙纹碗(见图1)，造型、纹饰皆与宣德官窑青花龙纹碗(见图2)相仿，在瓷器设计上二者唯独款识有异，承宣德官窑署款遗制，更之为“大明成化年制”。 ／ [S22] 1、熟褐：颜色失透无光泽，仅见于成化仿宣德莲池鸳鸯纹盘。
facts.note: S33 discusses transmitted pieces (e.g. a David Foundation bowl), not stratified finds; S22 gives the kiln-site Chenghua copy of the Xuande dish. Different points, each single-sourced. No free source was found reporting Xuande-MARKED sherds in Chenghua strata.

facts.text: The 2014 excavation's Chenghua–Hongzhi phase (1465–1505) yielded mostly sherds with a cobalt double-ring six-character two-line 大明成化年制 in the foot. Two pieces carried 大明弘治年制.
facts.quote_zh: [S29] 外底施白釉，略泛青，足心多有青花双圈“大明成化年制” 六字双行楷书款，有两件带“大明弘治年制” 六字双行楷书款。

facts.text: Hongzhi imperial wares are mostly marked on the base with cobalt 大明弘治年制, six characters in two lines of regular script within a double ring. Exceptions include a seal-script four-character 弘治年制 incised in the centre of a yellow-ground green-dragon stem bowl. A kiln-site biscuit stem bowl with an incised seal-script 弘治年制 was first shown in 2020.
facts.quote_zh: [S14] 弘治朝御窑瓷器大都在外底署年款，款识内容基本都是“大明弘治年制”，以青料书写，楷体六字作双行排列，外围青花双圈。个别器物如黄地绿彩推拱云龙绞高足碗，在内底锥拱篆体“弘治年制”四字双行款。 ／ [S06] 展览第三单元展出的正统至天顺朝青花加矾红彩海水龙纹梨形执壶（修复）、弘治朝白釉黄彩梵文碗（残）、弘治朝涩胎锥拱“弘治年制”篆书款高足碗（残）、正德朝黄地青花八思巴文款花卉纹碗（残）、嘉靖朝矾红地绿彩盘（残）、弘治朝内黄釉外洒蓝地孔雀绿彩云龙纹碗（残）等，虽残尤珍，均属于首次展出或修复后首次公开展出的难得一见的品种，相信展出后一定会丰富人们对明代景德镇御窑彩瓷的认识。 ／ [S29] 外底施白釉，略泛青，足心多有青花双圈“大明成化年制” 六字双行楷书款，有两件带“大明弘治年制” 六字双行楷书款。

facts.text: Hongzhi white glaze is slightly grey or bluish with a jade-like quality. Hongzhi poured-yellow (浇黄) is rated the best of the Ming and Qing, called 'chicken-fat yellow' and 'delicate yellow' (娇黄). Deep aubergine glaze first appears in Hongzhi.
facts.quote_zh: [S14] 其白釉瓷器色白中略泛灰或青，玉质感很强。 ／ [S14] 弘冶朝浇黄釉瓷器不但产置大，而且质置高，堪称明、清两代浇黄釉瓷器之冠，深茄皮紫釉瓷器则为弘治朝首创。 ／ [S03] 尤其是浇黄釉瓷器，温润如鸡油，色泽娇嫩，博得“娇黄”之美称。

facts.text: Hongzhi blue-and-white continues the Chenghua style in finer, more delicate drawing, with soft pale blue from domestic Pingdeng cobalt (Leping, Jiangxi), which is low in iron and high in manganese. Doucai was no longer made under Hongzhi.
facts.quote_zh: [S14] 弘治朝御窑青花瓷继承了成化时期的特点，只是纹饰更加纤巧细致、舒展流畅，所用青料仍为产于今江西乐平县的“平等青”，这种颜料中氧化铁含量低，氧化锰含量高，致使图案纹饰呈现出柔和、淡雅、清爽的蓝色。 ／ [S14] 成化朝盛极一时的斗彩瓷器在弘治朝已停止烧造。

facts.text: About 16 Hongzhi ware types are known, roughly half of Chenghua's 29. Production shrank and decoration was relatively plain.
facts.quote_zh: [S03] 目前统计弘治朝景德镇御器厂所烧造瓷器品种大约有16 种，几乎只有前朝成化所烧造约29 个品种的一半。 ／ [S14] 目前统计弘治朝景德镇御器厂所烧造瓷器品种大约有16个，几乎只有前朝成化所烧造约29个品种的一半。
facts.note: S14 reprints the Palace text; effectively one source.

facts.text: Zhengde marks are cobalt six-character 大明正德年制 or four-character 正德年制, double-ringed, in two lines of regular script. Both appear in the 2014 Zhengde strata. A semi-finished flowerpot from 2014 has 正德年制 written horizontally below the rim, which is very rare, and an incised 正德年制 flowerpot was also found.
facts.quote_zh: [S29] 外底均施白釉， 略泛青，部分足心有青花双圈“大明正德年制” 六字双行楷书款或“正德年制”四字双行楷书款。 ／ [S21] 其中出土一件侈口鼓腹花盆半成品，外壁模印龙纹，口沿下以青花横书“正德年制”四字，非常少见。 ／ [S14] 所署年款既有青花楷体 “大明正德年制”六字款，也有“正德年制”四字款和“大明宣德年制”仿款，更有稀见的八思巴文款。

facts.text: Zhengde imperial production includes pieces with an apocryphal 大明宣德年制 mark, for example a wucai fish-and-water-weed dish with a Xuande mark shown as Zhengde.
facts.quote_zh: [S14] 所署年款既有青花楷体 “大明正德年制”六字款，也有“正德年制”四字款和“大明宣德年制”仿款，更有稀见的八思巴文款。 ／ [S14] 仿宣德款五彩鱼藻纹盘
facts.note: Single source (Palace show text as reported by The Paper). Not stated to be a kiln-site find.

facts.text: Zhengde alone among Ming reigns used a four-character mark in 'Phags-pa script. Kiln-site examples include semi-finished bowls and dishes from the late-Zhengde strata of 2014 and a yellow-ground blue-and-white bowl shown in 2020. Every published statement of this traces back to the Palace Museum's 2017 Hongzhi–Zhengde exhibition and its catalogue: well attested, but not independently confirmed.
facts.quote_zh: [S03] 以八思巴文署四字年款亦为明代各朝御窑瓷器上所仅见，呈现一种非常有趣的现象。 ／ [S29] 另有一类带八思巴文“正德年制”款的彩瓷半成品碗、盘，除内壁刻划纹饰以外，在外壁多以瓷泥沥粉法装饰云龙纹，近足处同样饰一周仰莲瓣； ／ [S06] 展览第三单元展出的正统至天顺朝青花加矾红彩海水龙纹梨形执壶（修复）、弘治朝白釉黄彩梵文碗（残）、弘治朝涩胎锥拱“弘治年制”篆书款高足碗（残）、正德朝黄地青花八思巴文款花卉纹碗（残）、嘉靖朝矾红地绿彩盘（残）、弘治朝内黄釉外洒蓝地孔雀绿彩云龙纹碗（残）等，虽残尤珍，均属于首次展出或修复后首次公开展出的难得一见的品种，相信展出后一定会丰富人们对明代景德镇御窑彩瓷的认识。
facts.note: Reading conflict: The Paper (S14) glosses the 'Phags-pa mark as 至正年制; the excavators (S29) read it as 正德年制. Treat S14's gloss as an error unless confirmed.

facts.text: A new mark type appears in late-Zhengde strata: underglaze-cobalt characters inside an overglaze iron-red double ring in place of the usual cobalt ring, a combined over- and underglaze mark found on doucai.
facts.quote_zh: [S29] 另还出现了釉上釉下结合的款识[31]，常见的青花双圈被红彩双圈所取代（图一四），形成了釉上双圈和釉下文字的复合彩款识；

facts.text: The 2014 stratigraphy splits Zhengde into an early phase (1506–1513) and a late phase (1514–1521). The excavated area had many semi-finished overglaze pieces (glazed inside and on the base, biscuit outside), read as an enamelling workshop (色作).
facts.quote_zh: [S29] 本次发掘的一个重要收获是通过地层的叠压关系，将正德时期分为前后两段。 ／ [S08] 2014年，在御窑厂西侧、龙珠阁以南的发掘区域，出土了明代正德釉上彩瓷器半成品，包括花盆，渣斗，成摞的碗、盘等。
facts.note: Early/late split is S29 only; the semi-finished overglaze finds have two sources (S08, S21).

facts.text: Zhengde is a turning point: bodies get heavier, forms more numerous and decoration denser than the light, sparse Chenghua–Hongzhi manner. There are 20+ ware types, with peacock-green and blue-and-white, sancai, and peacock-green glaze the most admired.
facts.quote_zh: [S03] 正德朝是明代景德镇御窑瓷器发展史上一个承上启下的转折点，主要表现在逐渐摆脱了成化、弘治朝御窑瓷器胎体轻薄、造型较少、装饰疏朗等特点，器物胎体趋于厚重、造型逐渐增多、装饰偏向繁缛等。 ／ [S14] 正德朝是明代景德镇御窑瓷器发展史上一个承上启下的转折点，主要表现在逐渐摆脱了成化、弘治朝御窑瓷器胎体轻薄、造型较少、装饰疏朗等特点，而变得器物胎体趋于厚重、造型逐渐增多、装饰偏向繁缛等。
facts.note: S14 reprints the Palace text; effectively one source.

facts.text: The most distinctive Zhengde decoration is the heavy use of Arabic and Persian script.
facts.quote_zh: [S03] 正德御窑瓷器在装饰上的最显著特点是大量使用阿拉伯文、波斯文作为装饰。

facts.text: In the 2014 Jiajing strata most pieces are official wares with a cobalt double-ring six-character two-line 大明嘉靖年制 in regular script on the base, with a small share of private-kiln wares.
facts.quote_zh: [S29] 器物大多为外底带有青花双圈 “大明嘉靖年制”六字双行楷书款的官窑器，也有少量民窑器[39]。 ／ [S21] 明嘉靖年制”青花款器物、矾红彩半成品、低温釉半成品、民窑青

facts.text: From Jiajing onward private kilns also fired imperial orders ('official orders fired at private kilns', 官搭民烧). Jiajing-marked official wares have been excavated at private kiln sites: Guanyinge (2007) and Luomaqiao.
facts.quote_zh: [S29] 2007 年在发掘观音阁窑址时，在地层中出土了带有“大明嘉靖年制”款的官窑瓷器，被认为是御器厂的管理机构委派生产的[52]。 ／ [S40] 从出土的元代高等级建材与元青花、明初皇家用瓷器建材和官式瓷器、明代晚期带嘉靖年款的瓷器均可以看到，落马桥窑场可能和元代浮梁瓷局有关，并参与明代早期官用建材和明代晚期官搭民烧日用瓷器的生产。 ／ [S05] 随着商品经济发展和海外贸易迅速扩大，民营瓷业产量和质量均比以往有很大提高，除大量烧造供国内外各阶层使用的瓷器外，还搭烧御器厂临时交办的御用瓷器，使这一时期御窑瓷器呈现出丰富的面貌。
facts.note: For dating: a genuine Jiajing mark does not by itself mean the piece came from the imperial factory.

facts.text: Typical Jiajing imperial blue mixes imported 'Huiqing' (回青) cobalt with domestic 'stone' blue (石子青), giving a vivid purplish blue. Melon-skin green is purest under Jiajing.
facts.quote_zh: [S05] 典型嘉靖御窑青花瓷器以进口“回青”料混以国产“石子青”料描绘纹饰，呈现蓝中泛紫的鲜艳色调，开创了明代御窑青花瓷器发展的新境界。 ／ [S05] 瓜皮绿釉是一种以氧化铜为呈色剂、以氧化铅为主要助熔剂的低温色釉，明代景德镇御器厂自永乐朝开始烧造，以后各朝亦多有烧造，其中以嘉靖朝产品发色最为纯正，本次展出的故宫博物院藏嘉靖瓜皮绿釉锥拱云凤纹尊堪称代表性作品。
facts.note: China Daily (S17) repeats the melon-green point from the same show.

facts.text: Jiajing output rose sharply, with many ritual vessels, large pieces and Daoist-related motifs and objects. Transmitted and excavated pieces show at least 37 ware types.
facts.quote_zh: [S05] 嘉靖朝御窑瓷器产量激增，祭祀器、大器品类多样，流行与道教有关的纹饰，而且出现供道教仪式使用的特殊器物，这些都与嘉靖朝特殊的政治、文化氛围和嘉靖皇帝的个人品位有密切关系。 ／ [S05] 从传世品和出土标本看，嘉靖朝景德镇御器厂烧造的瓷器在花色品种上不少于37种，其中最受人称道的是青花、五彩、瓜皮绿釉瓷等。
facts.note: S17 (China Daily) gives the same '37 kinds' figure from the same show; not independent.

facts.text: For Jiajing–Wanli as a group, the Palace Museum text describes much higher output, more forms, more large pieces, heavier bodies, somewhat rougher workmanship and denser, brighter decoration.
facts.quote_zh: [S05] 受此影响，嘉靖、隆庆、万历三朝御窑瓷器整体呈现产量空前大增、造型更加繁多、大件器物增多、胎体趋于厚重、工艺略显粗糙、装饰愈加繁缛、色彩华丽夺目的风貌。

facts.text: Most Longqing imperial wares end the mark with 造 rather than 制: six characters 大明隆庆年造 or four characters 隆庆年造. The Palace text bases this on both transmitted pieces and excavated sherds.
facts.quote_zh: [S05] 大部分御窑瓷器采用了区别以往的以“造”代替“制”字结尾的“大明隆庆年造”六字年款或“隆庆年造”四字年款。

facts.text: Longqing ware types are fewer than under Jiajing: blue-and-white, blue-and-white with iron red, yellow-ground blue-and-white, wucai, doucai, white and poured yellow. Output was still large.
facts.quote_zh: [S05] 从传世品和出土瓷片标本看，隆庆朝御窑瓷器品种较嘉靖朝有所减少，见有青花、青花加矾红彩、黄地青花、五彩、斗彩、白釉、浇黄釉瓷等。

facts.text: The 2014 excavation's phasing runs from a Jiajing phase straight to a Wanli phase. No separate Longqing phase is defined, so there is no published Longqing stratum from that dig.
facts.quote_zh: [S29] （一）嘉靖时期第六组地层对应的第五期代表了嘉靖时期（1522～1566 年）遗存。 ／ [S29] ▲图十九 青花敞口曲腹圈足碗（TN33W15⑨：17）内底（二）万历时期第七组地层对应的第六期代表了万历时期（1573～1620年）遗存。
facts.note: This is an absence in one report, not proof that no Longqing material was excavated.

facts.text: Few pieces in the 2014 Wanli strata are official wares, marked with a cobalt double-ring six-character two-line 大明万历年制 in regular script. Most are private-kiln wares. An earlier dig near the east gate found a white incised-dragon bowl with a double-line double-ring 大明万历年制 in a Chenghua-to-Wanli fill.
facts.quote_zh: [S29] 少部分器物为外底有青花双圈“大明万历年制”六字双行楷书款的官窑器，其余大部分为民窑器。 ／ [S25] （2）距地表1.2～1.4米为万历至成化堆积，出土遗物有青花双行双圈“大明万历年制”款白釉刻龙碗残器，“大明正德年制”款的白釉碗和青花龙穿花纹碗，弘治白釉刻龙纹碗、盘，成化青花残片等。

facts.text: In the 2014 Wanli strata official products dwindle almost to nothing. The excavators read this as the imperial factory closing and its workshops turning to private production.
facts.quote_zh: [S29] 本次发掘万历时期地层中出土的官窑产品减少，接近消失，可印证这一记载。 ／ [S29] 本次发掘清理了原生的嘉靖、万历时期地层，结合此前的一些发掘，可以看到，明中期在今御窑厂范围内普遍分布的官窑生产作坊，在这一时期大大萎缩了，许多官窑作坊，包括本次发掘的地点，都转为生产民窑器物。

facts.text: End of Ming imperial production: the Palace Museum gives Wanli 36 (1608) for the factory's formal stop. China Daily's report on the same show says work 'was officially halted in 1603'. The sources disagree.
facts.quote_zh: [S05] 景德镇御窑瓷器烧造受政治影响，致使量增而质减，御器厂的运行更逐渐陷入窘困之境地，最终导致万历三十六年（1608年）御器厂正式停烧。
facts.note: Conflict: S17 (China Daily, English) says 1603.

facts.text: When imported Huiqing cobalt ran short in later Wanli, domestic cobalt took over, the best being Zhejiang material, which gives a slightly greyish blue. Some 20+ Wanli ware types are known, with blue-and-white, wucai, yellow-ground green and aubergine the most admired.
facts.quote_zh: [S05] 万历后期，因进口的“回青”料短缺，青花瓷器逐渐采用“土青”料描绘纹饰，其中以浙江产的“浙料”最好，其图案蓝中略泛灰色，淡雅明快。 ／ [S05] 万历朝御窑瓷器造型、纹饰风格基本延续嘉靖、隆庆朝御窑瓷器特点，从传世品和出土标本看，约有20多个品种，其中最受人称道的是青花、五彩、黄地绿彩和茄皮紫釉瓷等。
facts.note: Aubergine as the best Wanli monochrome is also stated in S06.

facts.text: The Palace Museum's very large Wanli-marked blue-and-white dragon meiping were excavated (1956) from the Wanli emperor's Dingling tomb, not handed down. Dingling held six Wanli-marked meiping about 71–75 cm tall and two Jiajing-marked ones about 45 cm.
facts.quote_zh: [S05] 本次展出的故宫博物院藏明代定陵出土的青花龙穿缠枝莲纹梅瓶，形体高大，纹饰繁密，制作和烧成工艺难度较高，堪称万历朝御窑青花瓷的代表作。 ／ [S19] The other six meiping, ranging from about 71 to 75 cm in height, bear a mark of the Wanli period and a dragon motif.
facts.note: S19 is English; quote_zh field holds its English sentence.

facts.text: Since the late 1970s and 1980s, tons of rejected imperial sherds from the Hongwu–Wanli reigns have been recovered at Zhushan, and more than 1,400 pieces restored. Pieces kept in the palace collections are mainly in the Palace Museums in Beijing and Taipei, with some in the Nanjing Museum.
facts.quote_zh: [S06] 自20世纪80年代以来，景德镇市陶瓷考古研究所配合以珠山为中心的景德镇市政府大院基本建设工程，先后发现明代洪武至万历朝御窑瓷器落选品、废品和部分窑炉遗迹，经过抢救性发掘，获得数以吨计的御用瓷器落选后被打碎丢弃的残片和窑具标本，粘合复原出1400多件明代御窑瓷器，对深入研究明代御窑产品和生产制度具有非常重要的意义。 ／ [S12] 经抢救发掘，目前已黏合复原出１４００多件。

facts.text: Lü Chenglong (Palace Museum) says the kiln-site sherds settled the long dispute over when the Ming imperial factory was founded and resolved some problems in the study of Ming imperial marks.
facts.quote_zh: [S12] １９８４年从景德镇陶瓷学院工程系毕业后一直在故宫博物院从事古陶瓷研究的吕成龙认为，景德镇出土瓷器残片之所以很受业内关注，是因为它回答了学界长期争论不休的明代御器厂最早设立时间的疑问、解决了明代御窑瓷器款识研究中的一些问题，与大量传世明代御窑瓷器形成相互印证，弥补了传世明代御窑瓷器中的欠缺。
facts.note: The founding date is in fact still disputed (see Hongwu facts).

facts.text: A traditional summary of Ming mark character, quoted as broadly true to the objects: 'Yongle marks few, Xuande marks many, Chenghua marks plump, Hongzhi marks elegant, Zhengde marks respectful, Jiajing marks mixed.'
facts.quote_zh: [S32] 而且随着时代发展，明代各朝御窑瓷器上所署年款也呈现各自特色，前人有“永乐款少，宣德款多，成化款肥，弘治款秀，正德款恭，嘉靖款杂”[1]的评价，从实物看，基本符合事实。

facts.text: Geng Baochang: Chenghua imperial marks are upright and forceful, as if all written by one hand. Later copies never catch their spirit, so on a piece with a Chenghua mark the calligraphy alone usually settles the date.
facts.quote_zh: 成化御窑瓷器所署款识字体均挺拔有力，似乎出自一人之手笔。……应当特别指出的是，成化御窑瓷器上的款识字体风格突出，而所有后仿者均未能得其神髓。因此，对于署有成化年款的瓷器，若能善于观察款字，即可定其大概矣。

facts.text: Sun Yingzhou's 1950s rhyme for the six-character mark, as glossed by Lü Chenglong. 大: the tip of the second (left-falling) stroke is pointed-round and not set high. 成: the fifth stroke (the left-falling stroke) is straight and stiff. Its third stroke either drops straight down or bends over to the left. 化: the tops of 亻 and 七 are level, or the right side is slightly higher. 製: the horizontal of 衣 usually does not run past the knife radical 刂 on the right, and the character is mostly full at the top and narrower below. 明: the 日 is narrow at the top and wide below, or of even width, and the tops of 日 and 月 are about level. 成: the final dot may sit above the horizontal (head), level with it (shoulder) or below it (waist).
facts.quote_zh: 第一句是说款识中“大”字之第二笔“撇”画的出头尖圆，但并不太高。第二句是说“成”字第五笔的“撇”画直而生硬，第三笔则有直立向下者，……也有向左方弯倒者，……第三句是说“化”字左边的“亻”和右边“七”上端基本持平，或右边略高，但高低差别不大。第四句是说“製”字下半部“衣”字之“横”画一般不越过右方之立刀，“製”字大多上丰下敛。第五句是说“明”字左边的“日”多是上窄下宽或上下宽窄相同，与一般习惯写法不太一样。“日”“月”头部则基本持平，高、低差别不大。第六句是说“成”字末笔点，有点在“横”画以上的（正常写法，即头部），有点在与“横”画持平部位（即肩部），有点在“横”画以下（即腰部）。

facts.text: Worked example of the rhyme: on a Kangxi copy of the doucai chicken cup, the 大 of the Chenghua mark ends its upward stroke with a pressed (blunt) end rather than a pointed-round one, and the left-falling stroke of 成 is soft and weak rather than straight and stiff.
facts.quote_zh: 利用该歌诀仔细审视上述康熙朝仿成化斗彩鸡缸杯所署青花楷体“大明成化年制”六字双行款，可以看出其中的“大”字出头不是尖圆，而是顿笔；“成”字第五笔“撇”画不够硬直，而是显得软而无力。

facts.text: Plate 63 (Palace Museum bowl): the Chenghua mark is written with a centred brush, its tips hidden, its strokes vigorous and upright, 'unique in the Ming'. Only Wanli-period mark calligraphy comes close.
facts.quote_zh: 款字以中锋运笔，藏锋写出，笔画遒劲挺拔，在明代堪称一绝，仅万历时期的款识书体与之相近。

facts.text: A Chenghua kiln-site bowl carries a Xuande mark. The blue-and-white bowl with seven lions playing with a ball (Jingdezhen institute) follows a Xuande design and is marked 大明宣德年制 in six characters in a double ring. The catalogue calls it the earliest known Ming case of a later reign copying an earlier reign's mark. It was rejected for a warped mouth. (This disagrees with another source: see F053.)
facts.quote_zh: 外底署青花楷体“大明宣德年制”六字双行款，外围青花双圈。此碗纹饰承袭宣德样式，所署仿款为目前所见明代后朝瓷器上仿写前朝年款的最早实例。此碗因碗口变形而落选。

facts.text: A matched pair of Chenghua kiln-site bowls with the same scrolling flower design: one is marked 大明成化年制 in a double ring, the other with the four-character 宣德年制 in a double ring. The calligraphy of the two marks is similar. The Xuande-marked bowl has a larger central medallion. Both were rejected for poor blue and warping. (This disagrees with another source: see F053.)
facts.quote_zh: 一件碗外底署青花楷体“大明成化年制”六字双行款，外围青花双圈；另一件碗外底署青花楷体“宣德年制”四字双行款，外围青花双圈。款识字体相似，署仿宣德年款者，内底所绘纹饰较大。此对碗因青花发色欠佳和变形而落选。

facts.text: Jiang Jianxin passes on the suggestion (from Liu Xinyuan's 1993 study) that the childlike, awkward six-character marks on Chenghua official ware may come from the young emperor's own hand, echoing Xuande marks said to be modelled on the calligrapher Shen Du.
facts.quote_zh: 在款识书写方面似乎也受宣德帝影响，其成化官窑器上稚拙的六字年款可能出自少年皇帝之手（图14）。

facts.text: Rule stated by the catalogue for doucai cups: one Palace Museum doucai cup has had its base glaze and mark ground away, and 'from the marking rule of Chenghua doucai' it should have carried a six-character mark in a double square. Counts bear this out: all 26 Chenghua doucai cups in the catalogue whose mark is described have the six-character mark in a double square (kiln-site and Palace Museum alike). So do 12 of the 16 doucai bowls and dishes. The 9 doucai stem cups are marked around the inside of the foot, and the 10 doucai 天 jars carry 天.
facts.quote_zh: 外底釉和款字均被打磨掉。从成化斗彩瓷器署款规律推测，此杯原应署有青花楷体“大明成化年制”六字双行款，外围青花双方框。

facts.text: Kiln-site blue-and-white wares with Chenghua marks are mostly dishes, bowls, cups and stem cups. Censers, vases and jars with reign marks are rare. The excavated crane-necked vases are a Chenghua form, and some carry the reign mark written horizontally on the neck.
facts.quote_zh: 传世和出土的署有成化年款的御窑青花瓷器以盘、碗、杯、高足杯等较为多见，炉、瓶、罐类较为少见。／珠山出土的同类瓶有饰凤凰穿花者，也有在颈部横书成化年款者，

facts.text: Geng Baochang: Chenghua quality control was strict and substandard pieces were all destroyed. As a result, transmitted Chenghua imperial pieces of every type rarely show kiln faults such as warped or flattened bodies or crawled glaze.
facts.quote_zh: 从传世品和景德镇市珠山明代御器厂遗址出土物可看出，成化瓷器极注重制作质量，不合格者均被毁弃，因而传世各品种器物均少见夹扁、缩釉等窑艺弊病。

facts.text: Small cups from the late-Chenghua deposits at Zhushan come in dozens of types. Tea cups are the second most numerous, after wine cups. A kiln-site recumbent-foot cup with a wide, shallow mouth and a slightly thicker body is identified as a tea cup.
facts.quote_zh: 其胎稍厚，端拿不烫手，口坦而浅，便于散热。景德镇市珠山明代成化御窑晚期窑业遗存出土小杯达数十种之多，其中茶杯数量仅次于酒杯。

facts.text: Geng Baochang: Chenghua imperial kilns made few large pieces (private kilns made more). Common forms are stem cups, wine cups, dishes, bowls and jars. Drinking and tea were in fashion, so wine and tea cups are especially common, all small and refined. Among jars the 天 jar is the most prized. The most celebrated forms, all light and delicate, are the doucai bird-and-flower stem cup, the chicken cup, the scholars cup, the 'three autumns' cup and the 天 jar.
facts.quote_zh: 成化御窑瓷器少见大器（民窑产品则大器较多），常见器物以高足杯、酒杯、盘、碗、罐等为主。由于此时饮酒品茗之风盛行，致使酒杯、茶杯类器较为多见。各种杯的造型均小巧俊美，为世人所珍视。罐类当中以“天”字罐尤为名贵。／成化瓷器造型唯重纤巧，如最享盛名的斗彩花鸟图高足杯、鸡缸杯、高士图杯、三秋杯、“天”字罐等，都是轻秀异常的代表作。

facts.text: Jiang Jianxin's inventory of Chenghua official forms (transmitted and excavated), in four groups and 23 shapes, about 200 varieties counting glaze and decoration. (1) Daily use: bowls, dishes, saucers, stem bowls, stem cups (mouth 4.8–8 cm), small cups (mouth under 8 cm), tea cups (mouth about 10 cm), small cups with stands, and covered 天 jars. (2) Desk and garden: paint boxes, water pots, flowerpots with stands, rectangular flowerpots, begonia-shaped narcissus basins and bird feeders. (3) Display: long-necked vases, crane-necked vases, censers with scroll handles, li-shaped censers, cylindrical incense burners and duck-shaped incense burners. (4) Ritual: gui-shaped censers and gu vases.
facts.quote_zh: 1. 日常生活类：碗、盘、碟、靶盏、高足杯（口径4.8～8厘米）、小杯（口径8厘米以内）、茶盅（口径10厘米左右）、劝盘小杯及“天”字盖罐等。2. 文房与花园器：各式调色盒、水盂、带托花盆、长方形花盆、海棠形水仙盆、鸟食罐等。3. 陈设实用器：长颈瓶、鹤颈瓶、卷耳香炉、鬲式炉、桶形香熏、鸭形香熏等。4. 祭器类：簋式炉、觚等。这4类23种不同形制的瓷器如再按其不同釉色和纹饰细分，则成化官窑瓷器约有200余品。

facts.text: The doucai grape stem cup (flared mouth, flattened belly) is a Chenghua imperial innovation, called in Ming texts the 'five-colour grape flared-mouth flat-bellied stem cup'. The late-Ming Bowu yaolan ranks it above Xuande stem cups.
facts.quote_zh: 此种式样的高足杯属于明代成化御窑首创，明代人称之为“五彩葡萄撇口扁肚把杯”。……明末谷泰撰《博物要览》曰：“成窑上品无过五彩葡萄撇口扁肚把杯，式较宣杯妙甚。”说的就是这种高足杯。

facts.text: Doucai vases are rare among both transmitted and excavated Chenghua doucai. Chenghua doucai jars come in two forms, a tall jar and a squat jar.
facts.quote_zh: 不管是从传世还是出土的成化斗彩瓷器来看，瓶类器罕见。／从传世和出土的成化斗彩瓷罐来看，其造型主要有两种：一种是高体罐；另一种是矮体罐。

facts.text: Jiang Jianxin's rule of thumb for the same form in the two reigns: Xuande is large, thick and heavy, Chenghua elegant, thin and delicate.
facts.quote_zh: 相同的器形宣德有大、厚、拙的特点，而成化器则显得秀、薄、巧。

facts.text: Blue-and-white stem bowls (高足碗) in the catalogue are unmarked, unlike the stem cups. Of five, three Palace Museum ones are described as unmarked and the fourth's entry mentions no mark. The kiln-site lion bowl is unmarked except for a single cobalt 一 on the base.
facts.quote_zh: 无款。外底以青料书写“一”字。

facts.text: The catalogue has no finished Chenghua chicken cup. The reign is represented by a kiln-site semi-finished cup, painted in pale cobalt only, with a six-character mark in a double square, rejected for poor blue and warping. The later Kangxi (two) and Yongzheng (one) copies are compared with it. Late-Ming and Qing texts quoted by Lü Chenglong place the chicken cup at the top of Chenghua wares.
facts.quote_zh: 杯呈缸形。口微撇，弧腹，卧足。杯内光素。外壁绘青花月季湖石、萱草湖石各一组。……外底署青花楷体“大明成化年制”六字双行款，外围青花双方框。此杯因青花发色欠佳和变形而落选。／其最者，斗鸡可口，谓之鸡缸。

facts.text: Jiang Jianxin: Chenghua official kilns kept up the Xuande habit of imitating famous Song wares. There are many imitations of Song Guan, qingbai and Ge ware, among them censers, vases, gu, flowerpots and stands, conical bowls, octagonal stem cups and begonia-shaped narcissus basins.
facts.quote_zh: 成化官窑也有仿宋名窑之作，有大量仿宋官窑、宋青白釉、哥釉器的制品（图15至图23），当为宣德仿宋元之风的遗续。

facts.text: Geng Baochang's 'double-line' foot test: Chenghua foot rings are generally thin and deep. Where the foot carries two cobalt bands, they are neat and set tight against the bottom of the foot. The lower band, nearest the unglazed foot edge, is darker and the upper one paler. Geng finds this in eight or nine of every ten Chenghua pieces and recommends it especially for unmarked pieces.
facts.quote_zh: 成化瓷器圈足一般都较薄且深，凡饰有青花边线者，圈足高低虽不同，但却有同一种现象，即青花双边线都很规矩，紧靠圈足底部，且靠近足跟无釉处的那条弦线，颜色较深重，上边的一条弦线则显清淡。发现器物圈足上“双边线特征”虽属偶得，但在所见成化瓷器中，十之八九大抵如此。对于此时不署款识的器物，尤宜将这一特点用做鉴定时的参考依据。

facts.text: Chenghua bodies were made from finely processed clay. Bowls and cups are 'thin as paper', so held to the light the outside decoration shows through and can be seen from inside.
facts.quote_zh: 成化朝制坯的瓷土均经过精细加工，可塑性强，易于修坯，致使器物其胎体洁白细腻。碗、杯之类，胎薄如纸，器外壁纹饰可光照透影，在器内亦清晰可见。

facts.text: Typical Chenghua blue-and-white uses domestic Pingdeng (Leping, Jiangxi) cobalt, low in iron and high in manganese. It gives a soft, pale, clear blue and basically none of the iron-crystal spots of Yongle–Xuande imported Sumali cobalt. Painting is outline-and-wash: fine, unblurred lines filled with a pale wash.
facts.quote_zh: 从文献记载来看，典型成化御窑青花瓷器所用青料是产于今江西省乐平县的“平等青”，亦称“陂塘青”。由于这种青料中氧化铁（Fe2O3）含量较低、氧化锰（MnO2）含量较高，致使图案纹饰中基本不再呈现明初永乐、宣德御窑典型青花瓷器因使用进口“苏麻离青”料（高铁低锰）描绘纹饰所呈现的氧化铁结晶斑，而是呈现柔和、淡雅、清爽的蓝色，……成化御窑青花瓷器的绘画工艺多采用勾勒渲染法。线条不晕不散，宛如婉转游动的丝线，纤巧爽利，线条内染以淡淡的青料，

facts.text: Early versus typical Chenghua blue: early Chenghua blue-and-white resembles Xuande, painted in imported high-iron, low-manganese Sumali cobalt with a dense, bright blue and iron-crystal spots. It was made only briefly and is rare among transmitted pieces. Typical Chenghua blue-and-white uses low-iron, high-manganese Pingdeng cobalt and is pale, with basically no iron spots.
facts.quote_zh: 成化御窑青花瓷器可分为早期青花瓷和典型青花瓷两种，早期青花瓷器的风格与宣德御窑青花瓷器相似，使用进口高铁低锰“苏麻离青”料绘画，图案发色浓艳，泛有氧化铁结晶斑点。但这种青花瓷的烧造时间不长，故传世品较为少见。典型成化御窑青花瓷器由于采用产于江西省乐平县的低铁高锰“平等青”料绘画，致使图案发色淡雅，基本无氧化铁结晶斑点，

facts.text: Jiang Jianxin dates the two kinds of Chenghua blue by excavation. The kind 'still using Sumali cobalt, with black spots' is early-to-middle Chenghua (years 1–16, 1465–1480) and shows Xuande influence. The pale kind is late Chenghua (years 17–23, 1481–1487), and is what 'Chenghua style' means. He follows Liu Xinyuan's 1993 study for this.
facts.quote_zh: 中国硅酸盐学会编《中国陶瓷史》，曾根据传世品将成化青花瓷分为两类：即“沿用苏泥麻青而带有黑斑”一类和“青色淡雅而称著”一类。根据近年考古发掘资料证实：前一类青花为成化早中期（成化元年至十六年）的制品，其风格受宣德影响；后一类青花则为成化后期（成化十七年至二十三年）的制品，所谓成化风格便是指该期烧造的别具一格的瓷器。

facts.text: Geng Baochang: the thick glaze over pale cobalt often makes Chenghua blue look hazy, 'veiled by cloud and mist', and this shows most in the cobalt base marks. Darker-toned Chenghua blue-and-white resembles late Xuande.
facts.quote_zh: 但往往因釉层肥厚、青花色淡，而产生云遮雾障、若隐若现现象。器物外底青花款字色调表现得尤其突出。青花瓷器中色调浓重者近似于宣德晚期青花瓷器。

facts.text: Imitation Ge ware was popular at the Chenghua kiln: large quantities of sherds have been excavated, but the reject rate was high. Chenghua imitation Ge has crackle and brown-washed rims and feet that copy Song Ge 'purple mouth, iron foot', though the colour is painted on. Its glaze is glossier than Song Ge and lacks its buttery softness.
facts.quote_zh: 景德镇珠山成化御器厂遗址已出土大量仿哥釉瓷器残片，说明当时很盛行这一品种，但烧成时废品率很高。／这件仿哥釉八方高足杯较好地模仿了宋代哥窑瓷器的“金丝铁线”和“紫口铁足”特征，只是釉面光泽度稍强，缺乏宋代哥窑瓷器“润泽如酥”之感。口、足颜色亦系人为涂抹酱褐色釉所致，

facts.text: Chenghua underglaze red continues Xuande techniques in two ways. One is line-drawn copper red, as on excavated cloud-dragon bowls and dishes. The other is copper red applied in patches (宝烧), as on the three-fish bowls in Stockholm and the Taipei Palace Museum; sherds of the same bowl were found at the Chenghua factory site. After Xuande, underglaze red was made only rarely because it was so hard to fire.
facts.quote_zh: 从传世品和出土物看，成化御窑釉里红瓷器主要延续宣德时期的装饰技法。大致可分为两种：一是以铜红彩描绘图案纹饰的所谓“线绘釉里红”；二是鲜红釉的局部使用，被称为“宝烧”。所见成化御窑线绘釉里红瓷器有景德镇御窑厂遗址出土的云龙纹碗、盘等，鲜红釉局部使用的釉里红瓷器见有瑞典斯德哥尔摩东方博物馆和台北故宫博物院各收藏一件釉里红三鱼纹碗（图4），景德镇明代成化御器厂遗址也出土了当时落选被打碎的这种碗的残片。

facts.text: How to tell doucai from blue-and-white wucai (Lü Chenglong). In doucai the underglaze blue forms the whole framework of the design, so a semi-finished doucai piece (before enamelling) is a complete pale blue-and-white picture. In blue-and-white wucai the blue is used only as one colour and to place the overglaze painting, so the semi-finished piece is an incomplete blue-and-white design. Ming texts called both 五彩.
facts.quote_zh: 在斗彩瓷器上，釉下青花起主导或骨架作用，青花已构成整个图案框架，或者说是白描样稿；斗彩瓷器半成品（未施釉上彩）是一件图案完整的淡描青花器；而在青花五彩瓷器上，釉下青花只是被作为一种颜色使用，同时为釉上绘画定好位置，青花五彩瓷器的半成品（未施釉上彩）是一件图案不完整的青花器。／应引起注意的是，明代文献将今人所称的五彩和斗彩统称作“五彩”。

facts.text: The 'brilliant purple' (姹紫) is called the hallmark of Chenghua doucai. Sun Yingzhou's mnemonic for the Chenghua palette runs: 'bright red lightly brushed, green flashing yellow; brilliant purple thick but without lustre'. A catalogue entry adds that this dense, matt purple appears on only a few Chenghua doucai pieces.
facts.quote_zh: 彩色中的“姹紫”一色，更是独具特色，可谓成化御窑斗彩瓷器的标志。／对于成化斗彩瓷器的各种色彩，孙瀛洲先生曾有“鲜红淡抹绿闪黄，姹紫浓厚却无光”的鉴定要诀。／紫彩即所谓“姹紫”，色浓而无光，仅见于少数成化斗彩瓷器上。

facts.text: Sun Yingzhou's fuller description of Chenghua doucai colours, quoted in the catalogue. Bright red is like blood. Apricot yellow has a faint red flash. The water, leaf and mountain greens are all transparent. Brilliant purple is dense and matt. Peacock blue is deep, and peacock green is pale, kingfisher-like and transparent. Ochre purple is dark. Grape purple is like ripe grapes and transparent. 'Oil red' is heavy and glossy. Ginger yellow is dense with weak lustre.
facts.quote_zh: “鲜红艳如血，杏黄闪微红。水绿、叶子绿、山子绿等皆透明。姹紫色浓而无光。孔雀蓝色沉，孔雀绿浅翠透明。赭紫色暗，葡萄紫色如熟葡萄而透明。油红色重艳而有光。姜黄色浓光弱。”

facts.text: Chenghua doucai uses colours flexibly: one or two on some pieces, up to five or six on others, most often three or four.
facts.quote_zh: 成化斗彩瓷器在彩色运用方面灵活多变，按照器形和纹饰风格，或用一两种，或选用三四种，多者选用达五六种。用三、四种彩绘的较多。

facts.text: Chenghua dragons are mild-looking: eyes wide open, but soft in manner. Types include dragons among flowers, lotus-pond dragons and sea dragons. Most common is the kui (or 'fragrant-grass') dragon holding a lotus in its mouth, whose popularity the catalogue links to the emperor's Tibetan Buddhist faith. The kui dragon starts under Xuande and is at its height under Chenghua.
facts.quote_zh: 成化时期龙的形象较为祥和，虽双目圆睁，却颇具柔态。成化时期的龙纹可分为穿花龙、莲池龙、海水龙等，最为多见的是口衔莲花的夔龙，又称香草龙。夔龙为佛经中记载的神兽，其形象在这一时期瓷器上的盛行与成化皇帝信奉藏传／明代瓷器上的夔龙纹始自宣德朝，盛行于成化朝，与当时皇室崇信佛教有关，

facts.text: Jiang Jianxin: Xuande often rendered the same pattern in different techniques, for example the same day-lily dish in blue-ground white, blue on white and blue with yellow fill. This is very rare on Chenghua official ware.
facts.quote_zh: 尤其有趣的是，相同的纹饰却采用不同装饰来表现，如相同的萱草纹盘则有蓝（祭蓝釉）地白花、白地蓝花和青花填黄三种；相同的牡丹纹盘亦见有铁绘、青花与青花填黄三种。而成化官窑器中这类花纹却非常罕见。

facts.text: Dragon and phoenix decoration was restricted to court use under Chenghua. In Chenghua 13 (1477) the official Fang Xian was banished to guard the Liaodong frontier, partly for keeping dragon-and-phoenix porcelain at home (Xianzong shilu).
facts.quote_zh: 从文献记载看，成化时期饰有龙凤纹的御窑瓷器仅限于宫廷使用，禁止他人使用和私藏。成化十三年（1477年），一位叫方贤的馆员因私藏龙凤纹瓷器，事发而被贬官流放到辽东充军守边。

facts.text: Sanskrit and Tibetan inscriptions are a common Chenghua decoration, which the catalogue connects with the emperor's patronage of Buddhism.
facts.quote_zh: 成化御窑瓷器上常见以梵文装饰，当与成化皇帝崇尚佛教、大兴佛事有关。

facts.text: A kiln-site Chenghua doucai mandarin-duck lotus-pond dish follows the design of a Zhengtong doucai bowl excavated at Zhushan and was 'drawn from the old Zhengtong pattern'. Almost all of its design is outlined in cobalt with a double line, which the catalogue calls the key difference from Xuande overglaze-enamelled ware. (This disagrees with another source: see F053.)
facts.quote_zh: 此盘上的纹饰与景德镇珠山明代御器厂遗址出土正统御窑斗彩碗上的纹饰相似，当据正统旧稿描绘而成，其纹饰已绝大部分使用青料双钩轮廓，此为与宣德五彩瓷器的重要区别。

facts.text: A kiln-site blue-and-white covered jar with sparse cloud decoration and large reserves is read as semi-finished, meant to receive iron red or gilt flying cranes. It was rejected at the blue stage for poor colour.
facts.quote_zh: 此罐青花纹饰布局疏朗，留白过大，故推测其属于半成品，应填绘矾红或贴金飞鹤装饰，但在半成品阶段便因青花发色欠佳而落选。

facts.text: Chenghua wucai is scarce, among transmitted pieces and at the kiln site. There are two kinds. Pure overglaze wucai includes transmitted pieces such as the scrolling-camellia jar, the lion-and-ball yuhuchun vase, the mandarin-duck fish-lotus dish and the scholar-on-horseback bowl. Blue-and-white wucai is typified by the mandarin-duck lotus dish with a Tibetan inscription, known both transmitted and excavated. Doucai, by contrast, was made in large quantity and was highly esteemed.
facts.quote_zh: 成化御窑五彩瓷器产量较低，传世不多，可分为纯釉上五彩和青花五彩两类。纯釉上五彩瓷器见有传世五彩缠枝茶花纹罐（图5）、五彩玉壶春狮球纹瓶、五彩鸳鸯鱼莲纹盘、五彩高士骑马图碗等。青花五彩瓷器典型器见有传世和出土五彩满池娇图藏文盘（图6）。／成化御窑斗彩瓷器产量较大，而且声誉极重。

facts.text: Doucai with a single enamel colour: some Chenghua doucai is filled with only one green inside the cobalt outlines. Examples are a kiln-site very thin cup with five-clawed dragons and a Palace Museum straight-necked vase with scrolling tendrils in pale green. The catalogue calls such green-only pieces 'special doucai'.
facts.quote_zh: 此杯属于只填涂单一绿彩的特殊斗彩器。／通体以釉下青花双钩蔓草纹，釉上再按青花轮廓线填以淡绿彩。

facts.text: On a Yongzheng copy of the doucai sea-monster 天 jar, the 天 gives itself away: the gap between its two horizontals is too wide, and the left-falling stroke and the horizontals are not spread out enough.
facts.quote_zh: 利用该歌诀仔细审视上述清雍正仿成化斗彩海怪图天字罐外底所署青花楷体“天”字，可以看出“天”字两横间距离过大，“撇”“横”写得不够舒展。

facts.text: Lids on transmitted Chenghua jars are often not original. The catalogue identifies the lid of a Palace Museum doucai dragon 天 jar as a Yongzheng-period replacement. The lids of two other doucai jars (chrysanthemum-butterfly and lotus medallion) were made by Tang Ying on Qianlong's order in the intercalary 7th month of Qianlong 13 (1748), per the palace workshop archives. Few transmitted Chenghua doucai jars keep their original lid.
facts.quote_zh: 罐盖与罐体的色彩和纹样略有区别，结合内务府造办处档案记载可知，盖为清雍正时期所配。／此罐之盖当为乾隆十三年闰七月初二日乾隆皇帝旨令督陶官唐英（1682～1756年）所配。／传世成化斗彩罐中能保留原盖者，寥寥无几，

facts.text: Lü Chenglong: under Kangxi, Yongzheng and Qianlong, both the imperial factory and private kilns at Jingdezhen copied Chenghua ware in quantity and to a high standard. Some copies of form, decoration and mark together, such as the Kangxi chicken cup, the Yongzheng sea-monster 天 jar and the Yongzheng doucai lotus-medallion covered jar, are 'hard to tell from the real thing'. Look for flaws in form (copies are often slightly swollen and less elegant), drawing (too regular and stiff, less lively), the mark, and the finishing of the base and foot.
facts.quote_zh: 清代康熙、雍正、乾隆三朝，景德镇盛行仿成化御窑瓷器，御窑厂和民间窑场均有仿制。……如康熙朝仿成化斗彩鸡缸杯（图15、图16）、雍正朝仿成化斗彩海兽纹“天”字罐（图17、图18）、雍正朝仿成化斗彩团莲纹盖罐（图19、图20）等，无论造型、胎釉、纹饰、设色、款识等，均达到使人难辨真赝的水平。鉴别这类仿品主要还是应从造型、纹饰画法、款字特点和器物底足处理工艺等方面仔细观察，寻其破绽。比如说在造型方面，仿品往往略显臃肿，不如真品俊秀，……在纹饰画法方面，仿品往往画得过于规整、拘谨，纹饰不如真品上的灵动。

facts.text: Collecting drove copying. From the late Ming, praise by literati and collectors made Chenghua imperial ware sought after and expensive, and copying for profit began and has never stopped. The chicken cup, grape stem cup, scholars cup, 'three autumns' cup, flower-and-butterfly box and jars were famous from the late Ming. Shen Defu (Wanli yehuo bian) ranks Chenghua above Xuande. Late-Ming texts record a pair of Chenghua cups at the Wanli emperor's table valued at 100,000 cash.
facts.quote_zh: 明代晚期以来，随着文人品评和收藏古玩之风的盛行，成化御窑瓷器遂成为收藏者竞相猎取的目标，致使其价格骤增，一些利欲熏心的人则趁机进行仿制，以牟取暴利，此风至今经久不衰。成化御窑斗彩鸡缸杯、斗彩葡萄纹高足杯、斗彩高士图杯、斗彩三秋杯、斗彩花蝶图盒和各式罐等，早在明代晚期即受到文人雅士和收藏家的青睐，博得极高评价，／如宣窑品最贵，近日又贵成窑，出宣窑之上。／神宗时尚食，御前成杯一双已值钱十万，

facts.text: Wanli 'homage' marks: late-Ming Jingdezhen commonly wrote 大明宣德年制 and 大明成化年制 on its wares out of admiration (寄托款, 'homage mark'). On a Wanli blue-and-white bowl the Chenghua mark's calligraphy differs from genuine Chenghua marks, and the body, glaze and blue place it in Wanli. All nine Wanli pieces in the catalogue carry an apocryphal double-ring Chenghua mark, except a doucai bowl copying a Chenghua design, which has its own Wanli mark in a double square.
facts.quote_zh: 此碗所署“大明成化年制”款的字体，写法与成化御窑瓷器所署年款不同。从胎、釉特征和青花发色看，这件碗的年代应为明万历时期，所署年款为仿成化款的寄托款。／此碗所署成化年款属于寄托款，鉴于明代宣德、成化御窑瓷器烧造所取得的高度艺术成就，明代晚期人们对宣德、成化御窑瓷器非常推崇，致使当时景德镇所产瓷器上非常流行书写“大明宣德年制”“大明成化年制”等年款。

facts.text: Kangxi doucai chicken cup copy (Palace Museum): it is slightly larger than the original, both the blue and the enamels are too bright, and the mark strokes are thin and weak. The Palace Museum has more than ten Kangxi chicken cup copies. Their marks are the copied Chenghua mark, the Kangxi reign mark, or 外膳房 or 自怡堂玩. The iron-red 外膳房 mark is thought to be a Republic-period addition. The catalogue calls the Kangxi Lang kiln copies the best, almost indistinguishable.
facts.quote_zh: 此杯造型及纹饰均仿自成化斗彩鸡缸杯（参见本书图版93），但尺寸略大，无论青花还是釉上色彩，都过于艳丽，款识字体笔画也显得纤细无力，／故宫博物院藏有10余件康熙朝仿成化斗彩鸡缸杯，所署款识除了书写“大明成化年制”仿款外，尚有书写“大清康熙年制”本朝款和“外膳房”“自怡堂玩”等款识者。其中矾红彩“外膳房”款，被认为是民国时期后加款。／其中以康熙时期“郎窑”所仿水平最高，几能乱真。

facts.text: 天 jar copies by reign. A Kangxi doucai lotus-scroll 天 jar differs widely from the Chenghua original in form, drawing and mark and 'only copies the general idea'. A Qianlong one likewise only approximates. The Yongzheng sea-monster 天 jar is the most exact, with precise enamel filling, oily red and bright green, 'almost passing for genuine'. The catalogue says the Kangxi, Yongzheng and Qianlong imperial factory all made 天 jars, the Yongzheng ones finest. One Yongzheng doucai winged-dragon 天 jar has its 天 inside a cobalt double ring and a crackled outer glaze.
facts.quote_zh: 此罐系按成化斗彩缠枝莲纹罐仿造而成（参见本书图版136、137），但造型、画法、款字等均与成化原作相差较远，只是摹其大概。／清代康熙、雍正、乾隆时期景德镇御窑厂均有仿烧，其中尤以雍正朝仿品最为精致。这件盖罐即属于雍正朝仿古之作，其做工精细，填彩准确，所施红彩油润、绿彩莹亮明澈。从造型、纹饰到款识，均作纯粹模仿，几可乱真。／外底署青花楷体“天”字款，外围青花双圈。

facts.text: Kangxi mark details that betray copies: a Kangxi Guanyin vase carries 大明成化年制 in three lines. The catalogue says this copies only the wording, since no Chenghua imperial piece has a six-character mark in three lines. Other Kangxi copies in the catalogue carry the Chenghua mark incised under yellow glaze, or within an incised double ring.
facts.quote_zh: 所仿成化年款只是对成化御窑瓷器年款内容进行模仿，款字排列方式则不符合，因成化御窑瓷器上未见有六字三行排列。／外底暗刻楷体“大明成化年制”六字双行仿款，外围暗刻双圈。

facts.text: Kangxi doucai often combines filled enamels with overlaid washes (覆彩) on one piece, a practice described as common in Kangxi doucai. The catalogue says the Kangxi and Yongzheng copies of Chenghua doucai are the best of the later imitations.
facts.quote_zh: 明代成化斗彩瓷器名噪一时，极其珍贵，明代晚期以来多有仿烧，其中以清代康熙、雍正两朝仿品水平最高。……此种填彩与覆彩施于一器的做法系康熙时期斗彩器常见的施彩技法

facts.text: Yongzheng copies, per the catalogue entries. They are finer and more carefully drawn than the Chenghua originals, with richer colours (lotus-medallion and chrysanthemum-butterfly jars, 'ganoderma-cloud' cups). On a copy of the flower-and-butterfly jar, the enamels follow the cobalt outlines strictly, the red is rouge-pink (胭脂红) and the colours are lighter than Chenghua doucai. One chrysanthemum-butterfly jar copy carries the Yongzheng reign mark instead of a Chenghua one.
facts.quote_zh: 此罐系按成化斗彩花蝶图罐（参见本书图版138）仿烧而成。造型饱满，胎釉精细，严格按青花轮廓线填涂釉上彩，红彩为胭脂红，黄彩明亮，较成化斗彩瓷器上的色彩轻淡。／外底署青花楷体“大清雍正年制”六字双行款，外围青花双圈。此罐造型、纹饰均仿自明代成化作品（参见本书图版140），但与成化原作品相比，绘画笔触更显精细，色彩亦更加丰富。／与成化作品相比，画工更显精细。

facts.text: A Qianlong doucai vase with an apocryphal Chenghua mark is painted with the dense, regular 'foreign colour' (洋彩) technique, wholly unlike Ming and early-Qing doucai painting.
facts.quote_zh: 此瓶外壁所饰图案规整、繁缛，使用洋彩绘画技法，完全脱离了明代和清代前期斗彩画法，符合乾隆时期洋彩瓷器的绘画工艺特点。

facts.text: Catalogue count of later pieces with Chenghua marks (plates 244–310, 67 pieces, all Palace Museum): Jiajing 1, Wanli 9, Kangxi 38, Yongzheng 16, Qianlong 2, Daoguang 1. 58 carry an apocryphal six-character Chenghua mark (catalogued as 仿款), 4 a 天 mark and 3 their own reign mark (Jiajing, Wanli, Yongzheng); 2 entries do not describe the mark. Of the 58 apocryphal Chenghua marks, 34 are in a cobalt double ring and 13 in a double square (almost all on Kangxi–Yongzheng copies of doucai cups and bowls). 3 are in three lines (Kangxi), 2 incised, 1 circular around the base (Yongzheng) and 5 without a stated frame.
facts.quote_zh: 外底署青花楷体“大明成化年制”六字双行仿款，外围青花双圈。

facts.text: Jiang Jianxin: early Chenghua production largely imitated the Xuande official kiln in form, decoration and mark style, to the point that some Chenghua official pieces bear Xuande marks. (This disagrees with another source: see F053.)
facts.quote_zh: 成化前期产品多模仿宣德官窑，在器形、纹饰、款式方面多有模仿，甚至出现有成化官窑书写宣德年款的制品（图12至图13）。

facts.text: Many excavated Hongwu, Yongle and Xuande pieces match transmitted ones, but 'identical' pieces are only broadly the same: the decoration always varies in detail, which Lü reads as deliberate.
facts.quote_zh: 仔细比对可以发现，所谓造型、纹饰相同的作品，其实纹饰并不是百分之百完全一致，只能说是大致相同，其细部总会有变化。这或许是当时有意为之

facts.text: Xuande kiln-site types not known among transmitted pieces include a bright-red meiping with hidden sea-and-dragon decoration, bright-red oval narcissus basins, a bright-red peach-shaped ewer, a brown-glazed oval narcissus basin and a sacrificial-blue monk's-cap ewer.
facts.quote_zh: 宣德鲜红釉暗花海水云龙纹梅瓶、宣德鲜红釉椭圆水仙盆、宣德鲜红釉桃形执壶、宣德酱釉椭圆水仙盆、宣德祭蓝釉僧帽壶

facts.text: Some transmitted pieces have no excavated counterpart, for example the Yongle blue-and-white lotus 'press-hand' cup in the Palace Museum. Lü puts this down mostly to the limits of excavation. (This disagrees with another source: see F013.)
facts.quote_zh: 在传世和出土的明代永乐、宣德、成化御窑瓷器中，就有在御器厂遗址已发掘出土品中所不见者，如永乐青花缠枝莲纹压手杯、宣德青花蓝查体梵文出戟法轮盖罐、成化斗彩蔓草纹瓶等。这可能是因为当时根本就没有废品，但更大可能是考古发掘的局限性所致。

facts.text: Hongwu overglaze red-and-green wares are rare. One accepted example, a yuhuchun vase, has a short neck and full belly typical of early Ming, and its double-ribbed banana leaves at the neck are a Hongwu blue-and-white trait.
facts.quote_zh: 该器造型短颈硕腹，为明初典型特征，与1994年珠山明御厂出土洪武玉壶春瓶残片相似；而颈部绘双筋蕉叶纹为洪武青花特有画法。

facts.text: A Hongwu red-and-green dish sherd with an iron-red five-clawed dragon and yellow and green clouds came from an early-Ming layer at the northern foot of Zhushan in 2003. A group of Hongwu blue-and-white stem cups with dancing figures came from a Hongwu layer at the southeast foot in August 1990.
facts.quote_zh: 2003年景德镇明御窑厂遗址北麓考古发掘在明初地层出土一块洪武红绿彩云龙纹盘残片，该器以矾红绘五爪龙纹，以黄、绿彩饰云纹……1990年8月珠山明御厂东南麓洪武地层出土的一组青花舞蹈人物纹高足杯

facts.text: Yongle 'gold' decoration on excavated bowls and dishes is applied gold leaf, not painted gold; where it has flaked, traces of the adhesive remain.
facts.quote_zh: 上述金彩器图案不是描画成的，而是用黄金箔贴出，金彩脱落处留有粘金彩花纹的痕迹

facts.text: Xuande overglaze purple is opaque and of one tone, while Chenghua purple is translucent in two shades, so Xuande enamels look darker and heavier.
facts.quote_zh: 宣德紫不透明……成化紫透明（可能渗入石末粉）；宣德紫仅一种色调，而成化紫有两种色阶，即茄花紫和丁香紫。因此宣德紫看起来就比成化紫色调显得沉暗凝重。

facts.text: Wang Guangyao's stratigraphy of northern Zhushan, from bottom to top: Yongle kilns and workshops, Yongle pits of smashed sherds, Xuande sherd heaps and kiln waste, then interregnum, Chenghua, Hongzhi, Zhengde and Jiajing waste layers.
facts.quote_zh: 自下而上即由早及晚依次是永乐时期的窑炉群及作坊、永乐时期的瓷片埋藏坑、宣德时期的瓷片堆积堆和窑业垃圾层、空白期地层与瓷片堆积、成化时期包括碎瓷片的窑业垃圾层、弘治时期……

facts.text: Hongwu reject pits lie southeast of Zhushan at Dongmentou (the east gate), but no Hongwu kiln has been found. Since Zhushan did not yet exist before Yongle, Wang says the record that the factory was set up 'at Zhushan in Hongwu 2' needs rethinking. (This disagrees with another source: see F002.)
facts.quote_zh: 洪武时期的落选品埋藏坑在珠山东南即今东门头区域……但是洪武时期的窑炉在何处，至今尚未能从考古发现中找到任何线索。由于永乐以前并没有珠山，所以《景德镇陶录》等书所载“洪武二年就镇之珠山设御窑厂”便值得重新思考。

facts.text: Waste dumped over the abandoned Yongle kilns yielded a red bowl and a white jue altar vessel marked 宣德年制, so those kilns went out of use before the ninth month of Hongxi 1 (1425).
facts.quote_zh: 从叠压在永乐窑炉之上的堆积中出土有“宣德年制”款红釉碗、仿哥釉罐等及叠压在永乐时期作坊墙体之上的堆积中出土的“宣德年制”款白瓷爵祭器来看，此处堆积的出现时间最早也在洪熙元年九月以后

facts.text: Rejects were destroyed differently by period: smashed and buried in pits under Hongwu and Yongle, tipped against walls and into gullies under Xuande, and thrown out with kiln waste under Chenghua and Hongzhi.
facts.quote_zh: 或如洪武、永乐时期打碎后成坑掩埋，或如宣德时期倾倒于墙根、小沟处，或如成化、弘治时期打碎后随窑业垃圾倒掉。

facts.text: Hongwu imperial porcelain keeps the plain, heavy Yuan shufu manner: the body is thick, its quality uneven because the clay was unevenly refined, and the glaze mostly bluish-white, as on Yuan wares.
facts.quote_zh: 明代洪武时期瓷器还多保留有元代枢府瓷古朴浑厚的遗风，胎体厚重，因胎土淘炼粗细之差，胎质表现不一。此时瓷器釉面多呈青白色，为元、明两代瓷的共同点。

facts.text: The small-footed Hongwu bowl type began in Yuan and was still made under Yongle, but Yongle examples have thinner walls.
facts.quote_zh: 此类小足碗造型始于元代，永乐亦有烧造，但器壁较薄。

facts.text: Transmitted Hongwu monochrome red is extremely rare. A Palace Museum red dish with moulded dragons is singled out because its red is even and the moulding sharp.
facts.quote_zh: 洪武时期红釉瓷器传世极少，此盘通体红釉纯然一色，且印花清晰，是明初洪武红釉瓷器中难得的佳作。

facts.text: Sweet-white ribbon-handled gourd flasks come in two stages. Early examples have no foot and only the two edges of the base wiped free of glaze; later ones have carved Arabesque decoration.
facts.quote_zh: 该类扁瓶在做法及风格上有早、晚期之分：早期器物无足，仅瓶底两棱边去釉露胎；晚期则在瓶面雕刻阿拉伯式花纹。

facts.text: Yongle blue-and-white ribbon-handled gourd flasks and ruyi-handled flasks were copied at the Qing imperial factory under Yongzheng, though not in large numbers.
facts.quote_zh: 这种葫芦扁瓶在清代雍正年间景德镇御窑厂也有仿烧，但数量不是很多。

facts.text: The yuhuchun vase changes by reign: Hongwu necks are slightly thick with round full bellies, while Yongle necks are slender and long and the belly slightly drawn in.
facts.quote_zh: 明洪武时颈部略粗，腹部浑圆饱满。至明永乐，瓶颈部变得细长，腹部略敛，而颈腹部的变化也更为柔和、协调。

facts.text: Yongle and Xuande creel-shaped (鱼篓) jars differ. Yongle has a straight mouth, sloping shoulder, drum belly and round base; Xuande has a flared mouth, slanting shoulder, belly narrowing below and a footring.
facts.quote_zh: 明永乐器特征为直口，溜肩，鼓式腹，圜底；宣德时期器形为敞口，斜肩，圆腹下收，圈足。

facts.text: Many Yongle white and blue-and-white kendis were made as ritual gifts for Tibetan lamas, so their forms differ from earlier kendis; a sweet-white kendi was excavated with white monk's-cap ewers.
facts.quote_zh: 永乐官窑的白釉、青花军持不少是作为赐藏法器生产的，因此造型与前代有较大差异。

facts.text: The monk's-cap ewer as an imperial porcelain form probably began under Yongle, made for Tibetan religious use. Early Yongle examples are plain or incised, and incised ones come with or without Tibetan script.
facts.quote_zh: 在中国古代官窑瓷器生产中，僧帽壶的制作可能始于永乐。……永乐前期僧帽壶有素面、锥花之别，锥花器中又可分为有藏文、无藏文两种

facts.text: An excavated white square-spouted ewer has a rectangular spout opening, closer to the Islamic metal model than the gourd-shaped spout hole on transmitted blue-and-white examples, so the catalogue dates it earlier than they are.
facts.quote_zh: 传世的同类青花器流口作一葫芦形小洞，而此器流口为长方形，与阿拉伯地区原器更为接近，故其年代当早于传世的同类青花器。

facts.text: Ming stem bowls were made under Yongle and Xuande with a taller bowl and shorter stem than Yuan ones.
facts.quote_zh: 明永乐、宣德时继续承烧而造型较元代有所变化，碗身加高，足变矮。

facts.text: A black-glazed tripod censer from Zhushan (1999) has an incised inscription dated Yongle 21 (1423, guimao year) recording a votive gift. It is a dated piece, not a reign mark.
facts.quote_zh: 腹刻白书“永乐贰拾壹年岁次癸卯吉日喜舍湖坑大桥求”。……从形制与刻书内容来看，此炉应为供奉用器。

facts.text: Kiln-site trial pieces survive that transmitted collections lack, for example a 2003 bowl with random copper-red dots under white glaze, which the catalogue reads as a test of copper-red pigment.
facts.quote_zh: 内施红釉，外壁以铜红料作无规律点彩，再罩以白釉，圈足外壁也有彩点。……此碗应为试铜红料之器。

facts.text: Under Yongle and Xuande, potting moved away from the heavy, full Hongwu manner to a lighter, more graceful style.
facts.quote_zh: 明永乐、宣德时期，瓷器制作发生了显著变化，造型工艺一改前朝厚重饱满的特点，而转变为清新隽秀的风格。

facts.text: Yongle shapes that are new rather than inherited include the pear-shaped ewer (from Yuan, made under Yongle, Xuande and Jiajing), the creel-shaped jar, and the square-spouted heart-shaped flask, rare before Yongle. Jiajing blue-and-white versions of the flask look very different.
facts.quote_zh: 此壶系模制黏结而成，造型仿自金属器皿，永乐以前似不多见，嘉靖时期有青花制品，但造型与此器相去甚远。

facts.text: The Yongle bamboo, rock and banana-plant garden design with balustrade lasted into the Qing and was still painted as late as Xuantong, so the motif alone does not date a piece to Yongle.
facts.quote_zh: 竹石、芭蕉及庭院栏杆三者结合的装饰图案保留至清代，烧至宣统时期。

facts.text: Jiang repeats the attribution of Xuande mark calligraphy to the early-Ming calligrapher Shen Du: he wrote the model, which factory potters copied onto the porcelain.
facts.quote_zh: 据考证，宣德器上的年款，均出自明初著名书法家沈度之手（即由沈度书写粉本后，由御厂工匠临摹于瓷器上）。

facts.text: In Xuande borders the common upright and pendant lotus panels usually have filled-in centres, unlike earlier ones. One design may also appear in several techniques, such as a day-lily dish in white on blue, blue on white and yellow-ground blue.
facts.quote_zh: 辅助纹饰中最常见的仰、覆莲瓣纹，瓣心多填色，与前代式样有较大不同。尤其有趣的是，相同的纹饰却采用不同装饰来表现，如相同萱草纹盘则有蓝（祭蓝釉）地白花、白地蓝花和黄地青花三种

facts.text: The volume's EDXRF study summarises other research differently: Hongwu and Yongle used mainly imported cobalt, while Xuande and Chenghua may have used imported, domestic or mixed cobalt. (This disagrees with another source: see F026.)
facts.quote_zh: 诸多研究表明明代青花色料可以分为三个阶段，其中洪武、永乐时期主要使用进口色料；宣德和成化时期可能既使用进口料，也使用了国产料，还有混合使用的情况

facts.text: EDXRF of sherds from Hongwu to Chenghua finds a porcelain-stone plus kaolin body, with alumina mostly above 20% and rising slightly from Hongwu through Yongle and Xuande to Chenghua.
facts.quote_zh: 根据氧化铝含量可以推测胎体采用的是瓷石加高岭土的二元配方，且从洪武、永乐、宣德到成化时期胎体中氧化铝含量呈略微升高趋势。

facts.text: Wang notes that large quantities of early-Hongwu official-style wares have been looted from the Luomaqiao site in Jingdezhen. Zhushan was therefore not the only kiln making court porcelain under Hongwu, and an official-style Hongwu piece is not necessarily from the Zhushan factory.
facts.quote_zh: 从景德镇落马桥遗址出土有大量的洪武早期的官样瓷器看，当时承担为宫廷烧造瓷器任务的窑场仅在景德镇城内就绝非只有珠山一处，这也可证珠山御窑遗址所代表的洪武时期的遗存并不是专供御用的唯一窑厂。

facts.text: Wang argues the 'imperial porcelain factory' (御器厂) was founded only at the start of Xuande, as an office at Poyang under eunuch supervision. The Hongwu–Yongle Zhushan kiln was a traditional official kiln, a different thing from the factory that kilns, marks and reject handling show from Xuande on. (This disagrees with another source: see F002.)
facts.quote_zh: 据此可以肯定御器厂始建于宣德初年，其官衙在饶州府治所在的鄱阳县城内月波门外，该厂是每年进贡瓷器时太监检验所贡瓷器合格与否场所。

facts.text: Hongwu flat-rimmed dishes have thicker bases than Yuan ones, with unglazed bases fired flint-red. Hongwu cup stands have sand bases and large shallow feet, whereas Yongle stands have smaller glazed feet and Yongle cups have footrings.
facts.quote_zh: 此类盘比元代大盘底厚，足底无釉呈火石红。……此类器物永乐时亦有烧造，差异是永乐盏有圈足，盏托圈足较小，底有釉。

facts.text: Hongwu blue-and-white and underglaze red drop Yuan figure stories, fish and weeds, auspicious beasts and mandarin-duck ponds, and are mainly floral. Hongwu has few animal motifs and no figure subjects.
facts.quote_zh: 纹饰题材亦大量减少，如元代流行的人物故事、鱼藻、瑞兽、鸳鸯莲池等均不见，而以花卉为主

facts.text: On Yongle borders the midribs of banana leaves are mostly left unshaded, key-fret runs continuously, and waves contrast crests with spaced ripples.
facts.quote_zh: 蕉叶纹叶片中茎多不渲染；回纹多环绕连续；海水纹潮头与水波疏密对比鲜明

facts.text: Wang's kiln phases: Hongwu–Yongle used long-chambered gourd kilns in northeast Zhushan; Xuande used gourd kilns of the same plan in the southwest; after Xuande, mantou kilns. Kiln layout, mark practice and reject handling all change at Xuande.
facts.quote_zh: 洪武至永乐时期，流行后室较长的葫芦窑，分布在珠山东北部；宣德时期，仍然是葫芦窑，窑室平面形态和前一个时期相同，分布在珠山西南部；宣德以后，一直流行馒头窑

facts.text: A kiln-site stem bowl with a four-character regular-script 宣德年制 under the foot, its form and decoration copied from Yongle, is described as a very rare mark. The bowl appears semi-finished, with reserves probably meant for gilding.
facts.quote_zh: 足底书青花“宣德年制”四字楷书款，其款识十分罕见。……此器造型、纹饰与永乐制品相似，系仿自永乐器

facts.text: Only one transmitted Xuande monochrome cricket jar is known, a Ge-type example in the Palace Museum. The excavated jars greatly widen the known range.
facts.quote_zh: 从目前资料来看，传世宣德单色釉蟋蟀罐仅此一件，因此越发珍贵。

facts.text: Yellow-ground blue-and-white began under Xuande. It is either yellow all over or has a white reserve panel left for the mark, here a six-character horizontal mark below the outer rim.
facts.quote_zh: 黄地青花创烧于宣德时期，是在白釉上填以黄釉，再经低温二次烧成。有通体填黄及在书款处留白框两种形式，此盘属后者。

facts.text: On celadon-glazed Xuande dishes the blue mark is written under the green glaze in the inside centre. One catalogue entry calls the mark calligraphy the early-Ming 'cabinet' (台阁体) style.
facts.quote_zh: 款识书风规整，为明初宣德时期台阁体书法风格。

facts.text: Not every Xuande imperial piece is marked. A Qing-palace bright-red monk's-cap ewer is described as having white glaze inside the foot and no mark.
facts.quote_zh: 通体施鲜红釉，足内白釉无款。

facts.text: Ming stem bowls can be told from Yuan ones by how the stem is joined. Yuan stems are luted with clay, leaving a lump of squeezed-out clay inside the stem. Ming stems are joined with glaze, leaving a coarse intermediate layer at the join and a glazed nipple inside the stem.
facts.quote_zh: 元代高足碗的足与碗身是用胎泥黏结的，足内有一团黏合时挤出的瓷泥；明代高足碗的足与碗身是用釉来黏结的，足与碗身的交接处有一粗的中间层，足内底有一带釉的乳突。

facts.text: Xuande octagonal candlesticks have a 6.7 cm unglazed ring on the white-glazed base, left by a columnar support used in firing to stop the heavy socket sagging. The catalogue calls this more advanced than Yongle practice and a way to tell Xuande candlesticks from Yongle ones.
facts.quote_zh: 此器足内施白釉，底有一直径6.7厘米涩圈，乃装烧时垫有柱状支垫所致，以防焙烧时因颈部的插座太重而下塌。其装烧工艺比永乐同类器先进，此痕迹可以作为区别永乐、宣德烛台的标志。

facts.text: Eggshell-thin (脱胎) ware began under Yongle, but there only the rim was very thin and the base stayed thick. An excavated Xuande white cup is thin at the foot too.
facts.quote_zh: 脱胎器创烧于永乐，但仅口沿极薄，底部还是偏厚，而此器底足亦很薄，体现出了工艺水平的提高。

facts.text: Kiln-site finds date several glazes earlier than once thought. Cucumber-green (瓜皮绿) was believed mid-to-late Ming but is shown to be Xuande. Yellow glaze on porcelain began at the Xuande imperial kiln. Red with painted gold also begins under Xuande.
facts.quote_zh: 过去认为该釉出现于明中晚期，此器的出土证实瓜皮绿釉早在宣德时期已经出现。

facts.text: Sprinkled blue (洒蓝, 'snowflake blue'), cobalt with small white flecks, was created under Xuande. An excavated incised-dragon example has a double-ring six-character mark in the base centre.
facts.quote_zh: 洒蓝以钴为着色剂，蓝中夹以白色小斑块，分布自然，有如雪片挥洒在蓝釉上，又名“雪花蓝”。创烧于宣德时期。

facts.text: The earliest Ming imitations of Ge ware are Xuande imperial pieces, mostly marked in blue. Their glaze is less glossy and oily like true Ge, but shows Xuande orange peel; the crackle is faintly black or red, without Ge's 'gold thread and iron wire' or 'purple mouth, iron foot'.
facts.quote_zh: 明代仿哥窑瓷器的传世品迄今所见最早为宣德时景德镇御窑制品……多书有青花宣德年款。这些器物的釉面光洁度偏低，有油腻感，与传世哥窑器的釉面相似，但也有橘皮纹这一宣德官窑器的典型特征。其釉色有青灰或月白等，开片纹的纹路微微闪黑闪红，没有传世哥釉器“金丝铁线”和“紫口铁足”的效果。

facts.text: The catalogue says imported high-iron, low-manganese cobalt blurs in firing so Xuande designs are often unclear; a Palace Museum fish dish with pale, clear blue is praised as unusual. (This disagrees with another source: see F026.)
facts.quote_zh: 明宣德青花使用进口青料，此种高铁低锰料在烧成过程中易晕散，故所绘纹饰不够清晰。

facts.text: The Xuande underglaze-red three-fish stem bowl was copied under Wanli, Tianqi, Kangxi and Yongzheng. Kangxi copies are the most deceptive but have a less rich glaze, a less full lower belly and a stiffer stem profile.
facts.quote_zh: 这一品种明万历、天启及清代的康熙、雍正朝都有仿制，其中康熙仿品最为乱真，但釉面不及真品肥腴明亮，垂腹欠丰满，柄足造型线条生硬。

facts.text: Other Xuande forms the catalogue says were copied later: a foliate blue-and-white bowl copied by the Kangxi and Yongzheng imperial kilns, and the Islamic-style watering pot, also copied under Qianlong.
facts.quote_zh: 是宣德官窑流行碗式之一，清代康熙、雍正时期的官窑亦多有仿制。

facts.text: Forms the catalogue calls new under Xuande include the six-lobed pomegranate-shaped zun, covered bowls (合碗, found excavated in underglaze red, blue with underglaze red, blue with iron red and red-glazed versions), the peach-shaped red ewer, and large numbers and kinds of bird feeders.
facts.quote_zh: 造型模仿石榴的形象，构思巧妙，为宣德官窑新创造型。

facts.text: Blue-and-white bird feeders first appear at Jingdezhen in Yuan, but appear in large numbers and many forms under Xuande, including geometric and naturalistic shapes. The excavated ones are mostly marked horizontally at the mouth.
facts.quote_zh: 景德镇窑青花鸟食罐始见于元，到宣德时大量出现，品类较之前大为丰富，除各式几何形之外，还有像生器及鸟笼花瓶等

facts.text: Ming meiping are generally squatter than Song and Yuan ones, with raised shoulders and straight-tapering lower bodies. Xuande red-glazed wares are mostly small, and large red pieces are rare.
facts.quote_zh: 明代梅瓶器体一般偏矮，肩部向上抬起，线条饱满有力，腹部之下呈斜直状，显得雄健敦厚。……宣德时期红釉多小件器物，少见大器

facts.text: An iron-red three-fruit stem bowl excavated in 1993 has no recorded or transmitted counterpart; transmitted Xuande three-fruit stem bowls are in underglaze red.
facts.quote_zh: 传世品中宣德红釉三果纹高足碗较常见，但以铁红釉绘三果纹者仅见此器。此类铁红釉器不见文献记载，亦不见传世品。

facts.text: On genuine Hongzhi marks the three-dot water radical of 治 is in most cases set lower than the 台 on its right. On later copies the radical and 台 are roughly level.
facts.quote_zh: 弘治御窑瓷器上所署年款，“治”字左边三点水绝大多数均低于右边“台”字，后仿者则三点水和“台”字基本齐平。

facts.text: Dated pieces used as period standards, all from private (not imperial) kilns: a blue-and-white bowl inscribed 弘治三年 (1490), a pine-and-crane bowl marked 壬子年造 (Hongzhi 5, 1492) in a double square, blue-and-white from a Hongzhi 11 (1498) tomb in Chengdu, and the David Foundation vase dated Hongzhi 9 (1496), whose coarse decoration and dark blue show what some Hongzhi private-kiln wares look like.
facts.quote_zh: 在弘治民窑瓷器中，发现有署“弘治三年”款的青花缠枝莲纹碗和外底画青花双方栏内署“壬子年造”四字双行楷书款的青花松鹤碗，“壬子年”即弘治五年。

facts.text: A sancai Buddha-image base in the Palace Museum carries an incised regular-script inscription dated 弘治六年 (1493). The entry notes the Hongzhi imperial factory was known for blue-and-white and yellow wares and that sancai is rare, so the dated piece is an important reference.
facts.quote_zh: 座中部刻有楷体铭文“弘治六年岁在癸丑中秋月吉日喜拾（捨）专保男许弘清寿命延长福有所归者”。

facts.text: In the 上 volume the Hongzhi kiln-site pieces come from earlier digs at the imperial kiln site: 1987 (1), 2000 (7) and 2004 (9), plus one with no year. A further 28 pieces were handed over by the Jingdezhen Public Security Bureau. None of the Hongzhi pieces is listed as coming from the 2014 excavation.
facts.quote_zh: 2000年江西省景德镇市御窑遗址出土，景德镇御窑博物馆藏

facts.text: Geng's Hongzhi points: potting is neat and delicate, as under Chenghua. Dishes show a sagging base: the whole base sinks, so the ring where the foot supports it shows slightly inside. This began under Chenghua but is most marked under Hongzhi.
facts.quote_zh: 弘治瓷器胎体处理规整纤巧，与成化时期相同。……器形更加规整、柔美。盘有塌底现象。由于器底整个收缩下凹，致使器里圈足承托处微显凸露；此特点虽在成化时已露端倪，但弘治时最为显著。

facts.text: Geng's Hongzhi points on the foot: smooth and rounded, the foot wall slightly lower than Chenghua's, the inner wall vertical and of varying depth. Imperial blue-and-white dishes and bowls, like Chenghua ones, have a double cobalt line around the outside of the foot.
facts.quote_zh: 圈足处理光滑圆润，足墙比成化时略矮，内墙直立，深浅不一。御窑青花盘、碗之类和成化时基本一样，亦有“圈足外画青花双弦线”的特征。
